Senior Vision AI Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Vision AI Engineer to architect, lead, and deliver advanced Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and Perception solutions for real-time intelligent systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical leadership and hands-on engineering expertise, with proven experience building production-grade AI products. Experience in ADAS, autonomous systems, smart cameras, industrial vision, or Edge AI is preferred.

You will mentor engineers, influence architecture decisions, and work closely with cross-functional teams to build high-performance, scalable Vision AI pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Vision AI & Deep Learning

  • Design, develop, and optimize end-to-end Computer Vision pipelines, including pre-processing, inference, and post-processing.
  • Build and deploy real-time models for object detection, object tracking, image segmentation, calibration, and image classification.
  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate deep learning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX.
  • Develop robust image and video processing algorithms, including feature extraction and classical Computer Vision techniques.

2. Edge AI & Embedded Deployment

  • Optimize and deploy AI models on edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm platforms, using DSP/GPU/NPU accelerators.
  • Convert and optimize models using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, QNN, quantization, pruning, and other optimization techniques.
  • Develop high-performance C++ (14/17/20) modules for embedded Computer Vision applications.

3. System Design & Architecture

  • Architect scalable and modular Computer Vision systems using OOAD, SOLID principles, design patterns, and UML.
  • Define data flows, pipeline architecture, CPU/GPU/NPU execution strategies, and system integration approaches.
  • Collaborate with hardware, systems, and product teams to ensure real-time performance, reliability, and scalability.

4. Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and best engineering practices.
  • Take technical ownership of feature modules, delivery quality, and project timelines.
  • Drive innovation by evaluating new research papers, frameworks, and Computer Vision techniques.

5. Deployment & MLOps

  • Develop production-ready inference modules, CI/CD pipelines, and testing frameworks for Vision AI models.
  • Define and evaluate KPIs, benchmark model and system performance, and optimize solutions to meet product SLAs.
  • Support deployments for global clients and collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Expertise

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Computer Vision and Deep Learning.
  • Strong programming skills in C++ (11/14/17) and Python.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and ONNX.
  • Strong understanding of image processing, OpenCV, video analytics, and classical Computer Vision techniques such as SIFT and SURF.
  • Experience with deep learning architectures such as CNNs, ResNet, YOLO, VGG, segmentation networks, and sequence models (LSTM/GRU).
  • Strong understanding of model training, evaluation, optimization, and deployment.

Edge AI & Performance Optimization

  • Hands-on experience with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, model quantization (INT8/FP16), pruning, and model acceleration.
  • Experience working with GPU, DSP, or NPU execution backends and hardware-aware optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization for real-time and low-latency AI applications.

System Engineering

  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, memory optimization, multithreading, and low-latency systems.
  • Experience with UML, OOAD, and software design patterns such as Factory, Strategy, and Observer.
  • Ability to design modular, scalable, and maintainable software architectures.

Leadership

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical/feature modules.
  • Ability to conduct effective code reviews, establish engineering best practices, and drive technical excellence.

Good to Have

  • Experience building production-grade AI products in a product-based environment.
  • Familiarity with MLOps, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, and cloud deployment.
  • Exposure to ADAS perception, autonomous driving stacks, robotics, or industrial automation.
  • Experience working with real-time camera/video processing systems.

jobDescription:
Dear Candidates,

Please find below the JD :

  • Job Title: Quality Control Chemist / QC Microbiologist
  • Location: Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand
  • Industry: Pharmaceutical Contract Manufacturing
  • Experience: 2-7 Years

Job Summary : We are looking for a Quality Control Chemist with hands-on experience in HPLC/GLP/GC/Chemical analysis for pharmaceutical products.

We are seeking experienced and detail-oriented Quality Control Chemists and QC Microbiologists to join our Quality Control team. The ideal candidates should have hands-on experience in analytical testing of pharmaceutical products using HPLC, GC, GLP practices, chemical analysis, and microbiological testing. The role involves ensuring compliance with GMP/GLP requirements and maintaining high-quality standards for pharmaceutical products.


Key Responsibilities

For Quality Control Chemist

  • Perform analysis of raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples.
  • Operate and maintain analytical instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV Spectrophotometer, Dissolution Apparatus, and other laboratory equipment.
  • Conduct chemical analysis as per approved specifications and test methods.
  • Prepare and review analytical reports, worksheets, and laboratory documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with GLP, GMP, and data integrity requirements.
  • Participate in method validation, method transfer, and calibration activities.
  • Investigate OOS (Out of Specification), OOT (Out of Trend), and laboratory deviations.
  • Maintain laboratory records and ensure timely completion of testing activities.

For QC Microbiologist

  • Perform microbial analysis of raw materials, finished products, purified water, and environmental monitoring samples.
  • Conduct microbial limit tests, sterility testing, endotoxin testing, and growth promotion testing.
  • Perform environmental monitoring of manufacturing and aseptic areas.
  • Prepare media, maintain microbial cultures, and ensure laboratory compliance.
  • Review microbiological records and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, and microbiological quality standards.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. (Chemistry/Microbiology) or B.Pharm/M.Pharm.
  • 2-7 years of experience in a pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratory.
  • Hands-on experience in HPLC, GC, GLP documentation, chemical analysis, or microbiological testing.
  • Good understanding of cGMP, GLP, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

Note: Immediate joiners are highly preferred for this position. Candidates serving a notice period of up to 30 days may also be considered.


Thanks & Regards

jobDescription:
About the Role:

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and technology-driven Fashion Designer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about fashion design, styling, digital fashion, and AI-powered creative technologies.


The selected candidate will work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies and established fashion brands, contributing to digital fashion styling, garment visualization, image quality checking, fashion content development, and AI-assisted creative workflows.


This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early-career fashion professionals who want to build a long-term career at the intersection of Fashion, Digital Technology, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).




Key Responsibilities:


Digital Fashion Styling & Quality Control:


  • Work as a Digital Fashion Stylist and Digital Fashion Quality Checker (QC) for fashion-related projects.
  • Review digital fashion outputs, product images, garment visuals, styling, proportions, colors, fit, details, and overall presentation.
  • Identify design inconsistencies, visual errors, garment detailing issues, and deviations from the original reference/design.
  • Ensure digital outputs meet required fashion, styling, visual quality, and brand guidelines.
  • Analyse client requirements, references, sample images, and feedback and ensure accurate implementation.
  • Coordinate with creative and production teams to communicate corrections and required changes.
  • Maintain consistency across multiple products, designs, images, and project requirements.


Fashion Design & Styling:


  • Apply strong knowledge of Indian and Western Menswear and Womenswear to digital fashion projects.
  • Understand fabrics, silhouettes, garment construction, fitting, styling, color combinations, prints, patterns, and garment detailing.
  • Assist in concept development, mood boards, styling references, placement prints, and fashion presentations.
  • Review and interpret fashion references, product images, sample garments, and design specifications.
  • Support digital garment visualization and AI-assisted fashion content creation.


AI & Digital Fashion Workflows:


  • Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, MNML, Magnific, Grok, and similar platforms for creative ideation and fashion workflows.
  • Use AI tools for concept generation, image enhancement, visual development, prompt creation, trend research, and creative problem-solving.
  • Develop and refine prompts to achieve accurate fashion-related visual outputs.
  • Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, digital fashion tools, fashion trends, and creative workflows.
  • Explore new AI-assisted methods to improve efficiency, quality, and accuracy in fashion projects.


Client & Project Coordination:


  • Understand project requirements and implement client feedback accurately.
  • Manage project, design revisions, and quality-checking requirements simultaneously.
  • Maintain proper communication with internal teams and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
  • Follow project timelines, brand guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Maintain confidentiality of client information, designs, references, and project-related materials.



Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Technology, Textile Design, or a related field.

  • Fresher or 1-2 years of experience in Fashion Design, Fashion Styling, Digital Fashion, Quality Checking, or related roles.

  • Strong understanding of Indian & Western Menswear and Womenswear.

  • Good knowledge of:
    • Fabrics and textiles
    • Silhouettes
    • Garment construction
    • Garment fitting
    • Fashion styling
    • Colors and combinations
    • Prints and patterns
    • Garment detailing

  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is required.

  • Understanding of placement prints, mood boards, concept development, and tech packs.

  • Basic awareness or hands-on exposure to AI tools and AI-assisted creative workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and visual judgement.

  • Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to understand and implement feedback accurately.



Preferred Skills & Additional Requirements:


  • Exposure to AI-assisted creative tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI or similar platforms.

  • Strong proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  • Good proficiency in English, Hindi, and Bengali.

  • Professional, confident, self-motivated, and responsible approach to work.

  • Sharp memory and strong organizational skills to manage multiple sample revisions, client feedback, design changes, and project requirements.

  • Punctual and deadline-oriented with the ability to work within production timelines.

  • High professional integrity and respect for:
    • Company policies
    • Intellectual property
    • Confidential client information
    • Brand guidelines

  • Passion for fashion, creativity, technology, innovation, and continuous learning.



Good to Have:


  • Understanding of digital fashion and virtual garment visualization.
  • Knowledge of AI-powered image generation and image enhancement.
  • Interest in emerging Fashion Tech, Generative AI, and digital design technologies.
  • Understanding of AI-assisted fashion styling and content creation.
  • Experience with additional creative software or digital fashion tools.
  • Knowledge of CLO 3D or 3D garment visualization.



Preferred Educational Institutes:


Candidates from reputed fashion, design, and creative institutes will be preferred, including:


  • NIFT (National Institute of Fashion Technology)
  • J.D. Birla Institute
  • iLEAD
  • Bhawanipur Design Academy
  • Amity University
  • FDDI Kolkata
  • ESEDS
  • IIFD

Candidates from other recognized Fashion Design, Apparel, Textile, or Design institutes are also welcome to apply.




What You Will Get:


  • Opportunity to work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies such as Myntra and Amazon.
  • Exposure to projects associated with leading fashion and lifestyle brands including Raymond, Park Avenue, Dressberry, Roadster, Reebok, HRX, Turtle, Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, and Allen Solly Kids.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered fashion design and creative technologies.
  • Practical experience in digital fashion styling and fashion quality control.
  • Exposure to real-world client projects, campaigns, product development, and production workflows.
  • Collaborative and creative work environment.
  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of Fashion + AI + Digital Technology.
  • Strong learning and career-growth opportunities in emerging AI-enabled fashion workflows.



Location Preference:


Kolkata / West Bengal


Preference will be given to candidates currently residing in Kolkata or elsewhere in West Bengal.


Please Note: Applications from candidates residing outside West Bengal will not be considered.

We expect a strong grasp of how transformer models actually behave, including tokenization, context windows, attention costs, embeddings and decoding, and the ability to turn that understanding into systems that are accurate, fast and affordable at scale. jobDescription:
Job Title: TS Supervising Associate - SLTS Onboarding Employer Branding Specialist
Job Summary:
Talent Services (TS) provides service offerings where the extended delivery model is used along with high-quality skills and competencies delivered virtually. This is across service lines and regions - delivering non-repetitive project-based work through skilled, agile teams. The team in the virtual hub is an extension of the regional talent teams and will cover operational/non-transnational scope.
Talent Consulting TS supports specific Regions and acts as part of the extended Region Talent consulting team.
It works in a fully integrated way with onshore colleagues participating in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. The Team supports the Region in performing operational and administrative tasks to allow the onshore team to focus on consultative and strategic activities based on the priorities of the Region.
SL Talent Support VTH assists a specific Region/Country and acts as part of the extended Region/Country Talent Consulting team. The onshore team for this role is the Italy Talent Team. VTH works in a fully integrated way with onshore colleagues participating in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. The Team supports the region in performing operational and administrative tasks to allow the onshore team to focus on consultative and strategic activities based on the priorities of the Region.
This role will directly work with the Region Service Line Talent and Talent Development team to provide full support on onboarding, reporting, stakeholder management, communications, PMO activities and general administrative tasks. This position ensures smooth operations support. Should have a professional attitude to deal with highly confidential and sensitive information. Ensure being compliant with Data Privacy and Protection within local, regional, and global guidelines. Adapt to a constantly changing legal framework and growing business environment.
We are looking for a practical and detail orientated individual with excellent organisational, multitasking, and solution focused skills, with experience in the delivery of high-volume assignments.
Applications Used : SuccessFactors Report Centre, People Insights, EY People Pulse, Regional SharePoint sites, Power BI Dashboards, Qulatrics, etc.
Shift: Aligned to the shift timings/schedule of the Region
Essential Functions of the Job:
Responsibilities:
Pre Onboarding
  • Support in onboarding the New Joiner
  • Collection of newly hired names and Buddies for Service line
  • Coordinating with development team for updates on automation tools
  • Update/maintenance of onboarding portal texts and Metaverse environment
  • Extracting data from excel sheet using VLOOKUP and pivots for selecting invitees and maintaining data in teams channels.
  • Responsible for sending pre-onboarding emails to new joiners, counsellors buddies and coordinating with development team to keep email automation tool updated.
  • Update of onboarding documents/ SharePoint
  • Development of innovative technical onboarding tools
  • Pre onboarding Welcome day/week
  • Training sessions for Onsite Buddies - sending of information materials, coordinating with speakers (useful links, guidelines, etc.)
Day 1 / Onboarding / Digital Week (1 per month, 1 per each location, Rome/Milan/Bari)
  • Onsite-buddy training and involvement
  • Counsellors management on onboarding topics
  • Management of communication flow - email, management
  • Continuous engagement of key Stakeholders (Leadership team, Managers, SM, speaker), management and coordination of welcome in events
  • Invitations and coordination of digital training events
  • Quarterly review of written materials, with content owners
  • Management and coordination of digital events, scheduling event, Q/A management, follow up
  • Welcome day /week + Onboarding Post onboarding
  • Graphic elaboration of presentations for speeches
  • Management and coordination of onboarding, photographs of the event for sending follow up
  • Digital event management and coordination, event scheduling,
  • Acting as coordinator for webinars aimed for new hires including inviting speakers for participation, maintaining presentation material and sharing yearly calendar
  • Q/A management, follow up
  • Info-training sessions for the owners of the activities envisaged for the welcome day at peripheral offices
Post onboarding
  • Recall new hires
  • Sending post onboarding surveys and analyzing them on a monthly basis
  • Training sessions for headquarters Buddy groups - SL - sending of information materials
  • Systematization of materials and updating, continuous improvement approach
  • Check of attendance, welcome kits delivered, expenses
  • Listening activity: Qualtrics survey analysis of employee experience data.
Employee Experience Employer Branding
  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of Employee Experience and Employer Branding initiatives across Italy and Europe West.
  • Coordinate project activities, timelines, stakeholders and follow-up actions to ensure timely delivery of agreed objectives.
  • Maintain project documentation, SharePoint repositories, Teams channels, trackers and governance materials.
  • Prepare and update presentations, communication materials and management reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support the development and execution of engagement, culture and employee experience initiatives.
Employee Listening Insights
  • Support Employee Listening initiatives, including EY People Pulse and other engagement measurement activities.
  • Monitor participation rates and prepare reports, dashboards and stakeholder updates.
  • Support qualitative and quantitative analysis of employee feedback and survey results.
  • Assist in translating survey findings into actionable insights, presentations and communication materials.
  • Maintain reporting files, user lists and supporting governance documentation.
Research Employer Reputation Analysis
  • Conduct desk research and collect information from internal and external sources related to talent attraction, employee experience and employer reputation.
  • Support sentiment analysis activities using social media, review platforms and other available sources.
  • Consolidate findings into management-ready summaries, reports and recommendations.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency and quality of reported data and insights.
Job Portability
  • Support the implementation and continuous evolution of Job Portability initiatives across Italy and Europe West.
  • Coordinate the operational activities related to internal mobility campaigns, including planning, communications, tracking and stakeholder engagement.
  • Maintain and update job opportunity repositories, communication materials, FAQs and supporting documentation.
  • Monitor participation, applications and adoption metrics, preparing reports and insights for leadership and Talent stakeholders.
  • Support the analysis of internal mobility trends and employee feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate activities with Talent teams, Service Line leaders and other stakeholders involved in internal mobility initiatives.
  • Prepare presentations, status updates and communication materials for governance meetings and leadership reviews.
Pre-Boarding Experience
  • Own and maintain the Italy Pre-Boarding Portal, ensuring content accuracy, relevance and an engaging user experience for new joiners.
  • Coordinate periodic updates of portal content, resources, FAQs, videos, links and onboarding materials in collaboration with content owners and stakeholders.
  • Manage communication workflows related to pre-boarding activities, ensuring timely and consistent information sharing with incoming hires.
  • Monitor portal usage, user feedback and adoption metrics, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate updates and enhancements of digital onboarding environments and related employee experience platforms.
  • Ensure alignment between pre-boarding content, employer branding messaging and employee experience initiatives.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of onboarding documentation, welcome materials and digital resources available to new hires.
  • Collaborate with Talent, Communications and Employer Branding teams to continuously improve the candidate-to-employee transition experience.
Communications Content Development
  • Draft, review and adapt communication materials in Italian and English.
  • Support the creation of leadership presentations, briefing documents, surveys, announcements and stakeholder communications.
  • Ensure consistency with EY brand, communication guidelines and visual identity.
  • Coordinate updates to communication templates and reference materials.

  • Support budget monitoring, vendor coordination and administrative project activities where required.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.

  • Experience using generative AI tools to support research, content development and reporting activities.
  • Mandatory excellent knowledge of the Italian language, both written and oral
  • Understanding of EY and EY Talent
  • Commercial acumen and business awareness
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
  • Attention to details, pro in project management
  • Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team
  • Drive and deliver quality services and products to Talent
  • Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
  • Strong IT skills - Microsoft Office 365 suite - Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, etc

About TYLsemi, Inc.
The Opportunity
The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package
Thats what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.
This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.
Why Now The Market Window
The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:
  • Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
  • Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

Culture Team: How We Work No Politics, No Bureaucracy
There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.
  • If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
  • No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.
Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  • US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
  • India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore
Move Fast, Ship Real Products
Were not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. Were building to win.
What We Value
  • Ownership mindset. Youre not here to execute someone elses roadmap. Youre here to define it.
  • Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesnt fly here.
  • Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people whove shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
  • Low ego, high standards. We dont care about titles or politics. We care about results.
The Ask
If youre reading this, youre probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.
Were asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.
Heres why you should:
  • The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what were building.
  • The team has done this before. Weve built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isnt our first rodeo.
  • The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
  • The work is consequential. Youre not optimizing someones ad click-through rate. Youre building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.
This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.
Or stay comfortable. No judgment.
But if youre the kind of person who wants to take the shot, wed love to talk.

","role":"
Role Overview
TYLsemi is seeking a Package Design Engineer to own design of IC packages (flip-chip, wirebond and 2.5D/interposer platforms) for high-speed digital and data-center-class products. The successful candidate will drive package design from bump/ball map definition through substrate stack-up, routing, signal/power integrity closure, and tapeout - working closely with SI/PI, silicon design, and test engineering to deliver package designs that are robust against real silicon feedback.

What You ll Do
  • Own end-to-end package design in Cadence Allegro Package Designer (APD) for design feasibility studies through tapeout: bump/UBM mapping, ball map planning, substrate stack-up definition, and fan-out/escape routing.
  • Route and close high-speed signal nets (e.g. Parallel interfaces such as UCIe, LPDDR/DDR; SerDes interfaces such as PCIe, Ethernet and UFS) using controlled-impedance and length-matching techniques.
  • Design and optimize power delivery networks (PDN) for IC package, including plane splits, decoupling strategy, and via stitching.
  • Partner with SI/PI engineering - use SIPI feedback to iterate and harden the package design.
  • Drive DRC/DFM closure with substrate vendors; manage design review cycles through tapeout.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical/thermal/reliability engineering on warpage, CTE mismatch, and underfill selection for package robustness.
  • Document design decisions, stack-up specifications, and via schedules for design reuse and knowledge transfer.

Must Have Skills
  • Proficiency in Cadence Allegro Package Designer (APD) and associated package layout tools (bump/ball map planning, substrate routing, stack-up definition) for flip-chip/wirebond packaging.
  • Demonstrated ability to close package designs against SIPI (signal integrity / power integrity) feedback loops - iterating stack-up, routing, and PDN design based on simulation and/or lab correlation results.
  • Solid fundamentals in high-speed digital signal integrity (impedance control, length matching, via stub effects) and power delivery network design.

Qualifications and Bonus Skills
  • Typically, 5+ years of relevant experience in IC package design
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical / Mechanical / Electronics Engineering, or related field.
  • Working knowledge of package-level SI/PI, thermal, and mechanical issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective cross-functional communicator, able to work with silicon design, SI/PI, test engineering, mechanical/reliability, and external substrate vendors.
  • Experience with Cadence SKILL or equivalent tool for design automation.
  • Experience with 2.5D interposer design using Cadence Innovus/Integrity (or equivalent) for silicon interposer / RDL routing.
  • Proficiency in Cadence Sigrity/Ansys HFSS/Keysight ADS for package level extraction/analysis of package/interconnect structures.
  • Proficiency in Ansys IcePack/Cadence Celsius for package thermal simulation.
  • Experience with advanced packaging, Cu Pillar bump technology, and fine-pitch UBM design.
  • Working proficiency in Cadence PCB design tools (Allegro X/ PCB Editor / Design Entry HDL) for board-level layout and package-board co-design.
  • Familiarity with JEDEC package reliability qualification standards and package-level thermal/mechanical simulation.
  • Bonus tools: Cadence Allegro PCB, Cadence Sigrity (PowerDC, PowerSI), Ansys HFSS , Cadence Innovus (2.5D interposer), Keysight ADS.

Senior API Platform Engineer
Job Level: Senior Officer


Job Summary
We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in TypeScript and Python , and you will own the Kubernetes deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user s shoes before shipping.


Roles Responsibilities
Building Platform Capabilities
  • Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
  • Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
  • Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
  • Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
  • Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow
  • Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes , writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
  • Ship through GitOps with Flux , so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
  • Configure the API layer in front of your services: routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
  • Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
  • Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking
  • Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
  • Review other people s code and take review well on your own
  • Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls


Qualifications Skills

Must Have
  • 3 5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
  • Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
  • Real Kubernetes experience: you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
  • Hands-on with Docker and Helm
  • CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
  • Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
  • Working knowledge of relational databases
  • You use AI tools every day , to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
  • Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
  • Fluent in English


Nice to Have
  • API gateway experience such as Kong , a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
  • GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
  • OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
  • Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
  • GraphQL
  • Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
  • Background in financial services or another regulated industry


Mindset
We are looking for someone who:
  • Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks 'would I want to integrate with this' before shipping
  • Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
  • Is curious and self-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
  • Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back

  • Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly

Design the prompts, eval suites and guardrails that decide whether an LLM feature is good enough to ship.
Prompting is engineering here, not trial and error. You will own the prompt and evaluation layer of real AI products: agents, retrieval pipelines and in-product copilots that run against live traffic. The job is to make model behaviour measurable and repeatable, so the team can change a model or a prompt and know, with numbers, whether the system got better or worse.


Responsibilities
  • Design, version and test prompts for production agents, RAG systems and copilots, and document why each change moved the metric.
  • Build evaluation suites that catch regressions before users do, with graded test sets and clear pass and fail thresholds.
  • Tune retrieval and context assembly so the model gets the right information, not just more of it.
  • Write guardrails and fallbacks for the cases that break a demo: refusals, hallucinations, jailbreaks and long-tail inputs.
  • Work with the engineers serving the model on latency, cost per call and token budgets.
  • Turn what you learn into reusable prompt patterns and eval templates the wider AI practice can pick up.

  • 2 to 5 years working with LLMs in a hands-on role, with shipped or near-shipped features you can talk through.
  • Strong Python, and comfort reading and writing code around an API rather than only using a playground.
  • A real understanding of evaluation: you can explain how you would prove a prompt change is an improvement, not a vibe.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings and vector search, and the failure modes each one brings.
  • Precise written reasoning, since most of this job is making model behaviour legible to other engineers.


Nice to have

Our clients span industries such as BFSI, telecom, education, healthcare, and various enterprise sectors. We are a growing technology company focused on innovation, automation, and building scalable products.
At Kevit, the Business Development Executive - cum - Telecaller is often the very first voice a prospective customer hears - the person who turns curiosity about our products into a meaningful conversation.
Why This Role Exists
As Kevits customer base continues to grow, we need energetic and communication-focused individuals who can reach out to prospects, clearly explain our offerings, understand customer requirements, and generate qualified leads for the sales team.
We are looking for someone who is confident on calls, comfortable working with targets, and genuinely interested in building rapport with customers. Freshers are welcome to apply.
This role is ideal for someone with 0-2 years of experience who wants to build a career in inside sales and telecalling, with hands-on exposure to real product and customer conversations from day one.
What This Role Is
A calling and lead-generation role focused on:
  • Reaching out to prospective customers
  • Explaining Kevits product offerings
  • Understanding customer requirements
  • Qualifying potential leads
  • Scheduling demos and meetings
  • Following up with prospects
  • Supporting the sales team in converting qualified leads
  • Achieving daily, weekly, and monthly targets
What This Role Is Not
This is not a silent, script-reading job.
The role requires genuine conversations, active listening, relationship building, persistence, and the ability to understand customer needs - not simply dialling numbers and moving on.
Role Overview
As a Business Development Executive - cum - Telecaller, you will connect with potential customers, understand their requirements, explain Kevits product offerings, generate interest, qualify leads, and support the sales team in converting prospects into customers.
You will work closely with the Sales and Product teams to route qualified leads, address customer requirements, collect feedback, and maintain accurate customer and lead information.
Your Growth Journey Month 1 - Learn Understand
  • Learn about Kevits products, pitch, and CRM/calling tools.
  • Understand the target audience and customer requirements.
  • Shadow calls and begin handling simple customer enquiries.
  • Develop confidence in product conversations.
Months 2-3 - Execute Build
  • Independently make outbound calls and qualify leads.
  • Handle customer enquiries and product-related conversations.
  • Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects.
  • Consistently achieve daily and weekly calling targets.
Month 4+ - Own Contribute
  • Own a steady pipeline of leads and follow-ups.
  • Prioritize high-intent prospects.
  • Schedule product demos and meetings.
  • Contribute meaningfully toward monthly sales targets.
  • Develop stronger product and customer-handling skills.
What You Will Do Day-to-Day Responsibilities
  • Make outbound calls to prospective customers and introduce Kevits products.
  • Handle incoming enquiries and respond to customer questions.
  • Understand customer requirements and identify relevant product solutions.
  • Explain product features, benefits, pricing, and offerings clearly.
  • Generate and qualify leads through calling, WhatsApp, email, and other channels.
  • Schedule product demos or meetings for interested prospects.
  • Follow up regularly with leads and maintain professional communication.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow-ups, and customer interactions.
  • Update lead status and activities in the CRM/system.
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling and lead-generation targets.
As You Grow
With experience, you will also:
  • Coordinate with Sales and Product teams regarding customer requirements and queries.
  • Collect customer feedback and share relevant insights with the Product and Sales teams.
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with prospects and customers.
  • Develop the ability to identify high-intent leads and prioritize follow-ups.
  • Take greater ownership of your lead pipeline and sales contribution.
What We Are Looking For
We are not only looking for prior experience - freshers are genuinely welcome.
We are looking for someone who is confident and energetic on calls, listens carefully, builds rapport quickly, and remains consistent with daily targets.
Non-Negotiables
  • Graduate in BBA, B.Com, BCA, or any relevant field.
  • Freshers can apply; 0-2 years of experience in telecalling, inside sales, business development, or customer interaction is an advantage.
  • Good verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone.
  • Basic knowledge of MS Office.
  • Good listening and convincing skills.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Comfortable working with daily and monthly targets.
  • Rajkot-based or willing to relocate, as this is an in-office role.
Good to Have
  • Prior experience in telecalling, inside sales, lead generation, or customer support.
  • Experience using CRM or lead-management tools.
  • Basic understanding of sales processes.
  • Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati will be an added advantage.
  • Interest in technology and software products.
Honestly - This Role Is Perfect If You...
  • Enjoy talking to new people every day.
  • Are confident and energetic on calls.
  • Are persistent and dont mind following up multiple times.
  • Are motivated by daily and monthly targets.
  • Enjoy understanding customer needs and recommending solutions.
  • Want hands-on experience in sales and product conversations.
  • Are interested in building a career in inside sales and business development.
This will not work if you:
  • Dislike making phone calls or cold outreach.
  • Get discouraged easily by rejection.
  • Prefer working without targets or deadlines.
  • Avoid repetitive follow-up work.
  • Prefer purely back-office, non-customer-facing work.
  • Are uncomfortable speaking with new people every day.
What You Will Learn
Most telecalling roles give you a script. This one gives you a foundation in sales.
During your time at Kevit, you will develop skills that can help you build a strong career in inside sales and business development.
Consultative Calling
Learn to understand customer needs and pitch the right product solution.
Lead Qualification
Develop the ability to identify genuine customer interest and prioritize follow-ups.
CRM Discipline
Learn to maintain accurate lead, call, and follow-up records in a real CRM system.
Objection Handling
Build confidence in handling customer questions, hesitation, and objections.
Product Knowledge
Gain practical knowledge of Kevits product offerings, features, benefits, and pricing.
Target Discipline
Develop consistent, target-driven habits and learn how to manage daily sales activities effectively.

Forward Deployed Engineer
Take an enterprise prospect from first technical conversation to a live, adopted deployment: scoping what is genuinely buildable, building the demo, the custom agents, and the skills yourself, and being personally accountable for the first moment the customers own team sees the product do something real.
What youll own
  • Pre-sale, technically. Sit in discovery, work out the minimal viable setup for this prospect, then build and run the demo yourself. You decide what is feasible; nothing enters a proposal without your scoping behind it, and your "no" blocks the line item.
  • The demo and the setup, hands-on. Configure the workspace, wire the data sources and connectors, seed the brand knowledge, and get the outputs looking like this customers brand. Not a spec you hand to someone-an environment you stand up.
  • Custom agents and skills, for the whole life of the account. Most enterprise requirements dont land as a feature request-they land as "our category model isnt yours," "this claim needs a compliance check we do differently," or "this report has to arrive in our format." You build the agents and skills that close that gap: writing them, wiring them to the customers sources and connectors, testing the output quality, deploying them into their workspace, and maintaining them as the requirement moves. This runs from the pre-sale demo through onboarding and continues once theyre live-it is not a one-time setup task.
  • Onboarding through go-live. Run the POC and the training with the customers day-to-day users, not just the executive buyer. Gather custom requirements directly, and be honest about which are configuration and which need engineering-the second kind gets flagged as roadmap evidence and never committed to a date.
  • The requirements trail. Enterprise onboardings run on daily standups where asks arrive informally, one at a time, for weeks. Keeping that legible-what was asked, by whom, what we agreed, what the customer still owes us-is a core part of the job, not admin around it.
  • The wow moment, as a number. You own the success metric for the journey from pre-sale to go-live. It has to be measurable, falsifiable, and meaningful to the people using the product daily-a dashboard only the buyer ever opens is a failed deployment.
  • Escalations inside your window. A blocked demo, a stalled data-access request, a POC going quiet: yours. Post-launch product issues route to Product; you stay involved only to settle what was actually promised.
Your day-to-day toolkit
This is the seats actual working surface-what an ordinary Tuesday looks like. We run AI-native internally, not as a talking point: the expectation is that you drive these tools yourself rather than asking someone to run them for you.
For What youll live in Building agents, skills, and demo setups Claude Code and equivalent agentic dev tools-writing skills, wiring MCP connectors, scripting against our APIs, automating the repetitive parts of your own job Customer conversations Clarify-call recordings, transcripts, and notes; every discovery, demo, and standup is captured there and is the raw material for scoping. Product and engineering handoff Linear-issues, projects, milestones; where a requirement goes when it needs engineering rather than configuration Prototyping an idea before it costs engineering time A working prototype is often the fastest way to settle a scoping argument. Proving adoption PostHog-is the thing you deployed actually being used, by whom, how often Comms and documents Slack (internal, incl. canvases) and Google Workspace-SOWs, requirement trackers, training material, status writeups The knowledge base A maintained internal wiki of accounts, modules, objections, and past decisions-youre expected to read it before a call and add to it after.
What "AI-native" means concretely here. You should be someone who reaches for an agent before doing forty minutes of manual work: pulling a transcript apart into a requirements list, reconciling a customers tracker against Linear, and turning a discovery call into a configuration plan. Much of the internal tooling around this seat is itself built as skills and scheduled agents-you will use them, and you will be expected to write new ones when you notice the same manual task twice.
The stack youll work in
We are not screening for an exact tool list-most of this is learnable in weeks by someone who has done the shape of the job before. What we do need is that youve worked at this altitude: built things against ad-platform and analytics APIs, handled a clients data on their terms, and shipped LLM-backed features you were responsible for the quality of. Read the lists below as "you should recognize most of a column and have real depth in some of it", not as requirements.
Must-haves
  1. You have carried enterprise customers end to end-discovery through live usage-in a technical, customer-facing seat (forward deployed engineer, solutions/implementation engineer, technical account, or delivery engineer). Not pure pre-sale, not pure post-sale.
  2. You build-including with LLMs. Comfortable in Python or an equivalent for real work: pulling and reshaping messy client data, calling APIs, wiring integrations, and standing up a demo environment without waiting on an engineering queue. On top of that, you can build an agent or a skill against a requirement and judge whether its output is actually good-prompting, grounding it in the customers own sources, evaluating quality, and iterating when its wrong. You will be asked to show something you built. See the stack section above for what we run-equivalents count, exact-tool matches arent required.
  3. Scoping discipline under commercial pressure. You can say "that isnt what this does" to a room that wants to hear yes and can tell configuration apart from engineering on the spot.
  4. You write things down clearly. Requirements, scope, escalation replies, and status. Half of this job is being the reason nobody has to reconstruct what was agreed upon six weeks ago.
  5. Enterprise sales-cycle literacy-you have worked with security reviews, compliance sign-offs, procurement, and customer-side stakeholders who control data access, and you route around them without over-promising.
Nice-to-haves
  • Regulated-industry deployments (BFSI, insurance, healthcare) and the compliance-boundary instincts that come with them.
  • Real depth in one of the customer-side categories above - paid media APIs, attribution, or martech/CRM integration-rather than passing familiarity with all of them.
  • Depth beyond the basics on agent tooling: multi-step/tool-using agents, retrieval design, and structured evaluation of model output rather than eyeballing it.
  • Having been the first or only person in a role like this at an earlier-stage company.

Job Summary

This role sits at the core of Product and AI Security engineering. This job leverages security expertise to resolve complex security issues, partners with teams to drive security initiatives, applies analytical skills to solve security challenges, contributes to security improvements, and influences security processes.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
  • Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company s context.
  • Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
  • Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for:

  • Build the end-state API security capability plane: Consolidate todays separate API security lint, gateway traffic visibility, shadow-API detection, and schema (GraphQL/AsyncAPI) security checks into a single, coherent capability that plugs into the orgs shared policy-as-code enforcement architecture - the same engine already governing container, static-analysis, and software-composition findings. Design the end state first - this is not a request to bolt on another point tool.
  • Take the pre-release API security gate from draft architecture decision to a shipped control, working with the Staff Engineer who owns enforcement architecture to get the gateway-level hard-block policy enforced end to end. This person unblocks stalled decisions - they do not wait for consensus to form on its own.
  • Own the dynamic application security testing (DAST) tooling strategy end to end: complete the current tool evaluation into a production migration decision, and execute it.
  • Extend API security capability into two domains identified as organizational blind spots - pipeline access execution control, and systemic artifact consumption verification - treating API security as one instance of the broader supply-chain security problem, not a silo, and enabling them through the shared enforcement architecture rather than a parallel one.
  • Be a force multiplier: mentor engineers across the merged team, unblock stuck initiatives, and drive delivery and innovation without waiting to be told whats next. Standard staff-engineer responsibilities and day-to-day routines apply in full - technical leadership, design review, on-call/escalation, sustaining engineering, and maintenance are shared responsibilities like any other staff engineer, not exceptions carved out for this role.
  • Shape the Roadmap: Work with the engineering manager and tech leads to shape and prioritize the teams backlog, identify emerging business problems before they become fire drills, and think beyond the current scope of the role rather than just executing whats already been defined.

What do you need to bring:

  • Software Engineering: 5+ years building production software with demonstrated staff-level ownership of a platform or system end-to-end, with hands-on coding experience in Python or Go - not just contributing features inside someone elses architecture.
  • API Security Engineering: Deep, hands-on expertise in API architecture (REST, GraphQL, AsyncAPI), authZ/authN (OAuth2 scopes, token/session models), and API gateway or service-mesh internals (Envoy-class systems or equivalent).
  • AI Knowledge: Working knowledge of how AI and agentic traffic is changing the API threat model - AI-driven API abuse patterns, agent-to-API authentication, and the security implications of agentic commerce - enough to reason about it directly, not just defer to the AI security team.
  • Working fluency in policy-as-code approaches to security enforcement and CI/CD security gating - you can write enforcement policy, not just consume someone elses.
  • Practical understanding of DAST/SAST tooling internals, deep enough to evaluate and replace an underperforming tool rather than just operate whatever is already in place.
  • Security fundamentals across product, cloud, and vulnerability management that go a bit deeper than most - you know why a control exists, not just that it exists.
  • Deep knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10 and common API abuse patterns (broken object-level authorization, excessive data exposure, resource/rate-limit abuse), and how to design controls that close them - not just cite the list.

Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI-powered recruiting technology, data-driven insights, and world-class candidate experiences. As a Resource Management Specialist within Radancys Global Delivery Center (GDC), you will play a critical role in ensuring our global delivery teams have the right people assigned to the right work at the right time.

Working across Digital, Creative and Customer Delivery teams, you will coordinate resource allocation throughout the full project lifecycle, partnering closely with Project Managers, Customer Success, Delivery Managers and functional leaders to balance customer demand, skills, capacity and business priorities.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically driven Data Analyst to join our Business Operations team. In this role, you will be the bridge between raw data and meaningful business decisions - maintaining accurate data across platforms, building clear reports, and working closely with cross-functional teams to identify and automate repetitive or inefficient processes. This is a role that sits at the intersection of data analysis and business operations. You will be expected to understand the 'why' behind business requirements, not just the 'what,' and translate those requirements into structured, automated, and scalable solutions. A strong grasp of data modelling, database architecture, and ETL processes is essential to succeed in this role.

Job Details

Work Timings: 10:15 AM - 7:15 PM; Working Days: Monday to Saturday (2nd, 4th, 5th Saturdays off); Work Mode: Work From Office; Location: Mumbai.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Management Reporting: Maintain data accurately and efficiently across platforms including CRMs (LeadSquared, Zoho) and Google Sheets / Excel. Update and manage recurring reports, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and timely delivery to stakeholders. Build and maintain dashboards using tools such as Looker Studio, Zoho Analytics, Metabase or Power BI. Identify and resolve data discrepancies, anomalies, and root-cause issues - not just surface-level fixes. Ensure reporting logic is transparent, accurate, and trusted by business teams.
  • Data Modelling: Database Architecture - Design and maintain clean, well-structured database schemas that serve as a reliable single source of truth. Apply strong data modelling principles - normalisation, dimensional modelling, and entity-relationship design - to support scalable data systems. Make informed architectural decisions around data structures, identifiers, historical vs. current data management, and schema evolution. Ensure data consistency, referential integrity, and reliability across all interconnected systems. Document data models, schema definitions, and architectural decisions to enable long-term maintainability. Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to align database design with business reporting and automation needs.
  • ETL Pipelines Data Orchestration: Build, manage, and monitor ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines to move and transform data across systems reliably. Work with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Airbyte, or similar platforms to schedule and manage data workflows. Use Python or SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading into target systems. Integrate data sources using APIs and webhooks to ensure seamless, automated data flow. Optimise pipelines for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency; implement error handling, retries, and alerting. Proactively monitor pipeline health and resolve failures or data quality issues before they impact downstream reporting.
  • SQL Data Analysis: Write and optimise advanced SQL queries for operational and analytical use cases. Extract, clean, and analyse data from relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery, or similar). Perform data validation and transformation to support accurate downstream reporting. Analyse data to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights for business teams.

Must-Have

  • 2-3 years of relevant experience in data analysis, analytics engineering, or a related role
  • Strong proficiency in SQL - ability to write complex, optimised production-grade queries including joins, window functions, CTEs, and subqueries
  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles - normalisation, dimensional modelling, and relational database design
  • Hands-on experience with database architecture - designing schemas, managing identifiers, and structuring data for both operational and analytical use
  • Experience with ETL tools or orchestration platforms such as Apache Airflow, Airbyte, Prefect, or similar
  • Hands-on experience with at least one reporting / BI tool: Looker Studio, Power BI, Zoho Analytics, Tableau, or similar
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data validation
  • Demonstrated ability to understand business requirements and convert them into structured, scalable data solutions
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics, intelligent automation, or LLM-powered data workflows
  • Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and logical thinking
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional coordination
  • A degree in a relevant field (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Commerce, or equivalent)

Should Have

  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as LeadSquared, Zoho CRM, or Salesforce
  • Exposure to cloud data platforms: GCP (BigQuery)
  • Exposure to automation tools - Make (Integromat), n8n, Zapier, or Google Apps Script
  • Familiarity with Python for data processing, transformation, and pipeline scripting
  • Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations
  • Ability to document data models, processes, and architectural decisions clearly
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a production environment

Key Traits We Are Looking For

  • Structured and process-oriented thinker who sees patterns in chaos
  • Thinks in systems and data models - not just individual queries or tasks
  • Proactive ownership - you improve systems without waiting to be asked
  • Genuine curiosity about data, databases, automation, and how businesses operate
  • Curiosity about AI-assisted analytics, intelligent automation, or LLM-powered data workflows
  • Strong problem-solving ability with a logical, methodical approach to challenges
  • Collaborative team player who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Willingness to learn and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced Finance Applications Administrator to join our Finance Systems team. This role is responsible for the hands-on administration, configuration, and support of the applications that power Five9 s procurement, expense management, travel, taxation, sales compensation, time tracking, usage billing, and financial planning processes.

The ideal candidate will have several years of hands-on experience administering finance or business applications. They bring strong attention to detail across system configuration, security, and data quality, and the communication skills needed to partner effectively with Finance, Procurement, Payroll, Sales Operations, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors across a global organization. This is an individual-contributor role rather than a people-management position.

The position is based in Chennai, India, is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, with candidates expected to work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time (IST) when needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary hands-on administrator for Coupa and Ramp, including system configuration, security roles, workflows, and approval routing.
  • Administer and support additional finance and business applications - including NetSuite, Egencia, Replicon, Xactly, Avalara AvaTax, LogiSense, and Workday Adaptive Planning - as assigned.
  • Configure and maintain system security roles, permissions, and access controls across supported applications in accordance with least privilege principles.
  • Design, configure, and maintain workflows and approval routing that support procurement, expense management, travel, taxation, sales compensation, time tracking, usage billing, and financial planning processes.
  • Maintain and support finance integrations, including Coupa- and Ramp-related integrations and other finance integrations with NetSuite, partnering with Business Technology and InfoSec as needed.
  • Plan and execute system testing, patches, upgrades, and releases, minimizing disruption to end users and business processes.
  • Monitor and improve data quality across finance applications, identifying and resolving data integrity issues.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards that support Finance, Procurement, Payroll, and Sales Operations stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain system documentation, configuration records, and process guides.
  • Provide day-to-day user support, training, and troubleshooting for finance application users across the organization.
  • Manage relationships with application vendors, including support escalations, renewals, and roadmap discussions.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Payroll, Sales Operations, Business Technology, and InfoSec to gather requirements and translate them into system configurations.
  • Support Five9 s AI Center of Excellence by identifying and supporting opportunities to leverage AI to automate expense management, procure-to-pay, and bill-to-cash related processes.
  • Stay current with new features and releases across supported platforms, recommending improvements where appropriate.

Key Requirements

Required:

  • Hands-on Coupa and Ramp administration experience, including system configuration, security roles, and workflow management.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience administering finance or business applications in a similar role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of financial business processes, including procurement, expense management, travel, taxation, sales compensation, time tracking, usage billing, and financial planning.
  • Experience managing system configuration, security roles, workflows, integrations, testing, releases, data quality, reporting, documentation, user support, and vendor relationships.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Finance, Procurement, Payroll, Sales Operations, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

  • Coupa and Ramp certifications are strongly preferred.
  • Egencia administration experience and a relevant certification are highly desired.
  • Experience administering LogiSense is a significant advantage and a major plus.
  • Experience with Replicon, Xactly, Avalara AvaTax, or Workday Adaptive Planning is a plus.
  • Experience with sales compensation platforms such as Xactly is a plus.
  • Experience with time tracking or payroll-related platforms such as Replicon or Deel is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work independently across a distributed, global team.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • You will play a key hands-on role in administering and improving the finance systems that power Five9's core business operations.
  • You will build deep expertise in Coupa, Ramp and a broader portfolio of finance and business applications used across the enterprise.

2070 Health is Indias first venture studio, established by W Health Ventures. It builds healthcare companies from scratch by identifying gaps in the market that remain unserved. Unlike an accelerator, the studio is directly involved in idea generation, daily operations, and strategic decisions as each company grows. Companies established in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech, BabyMD, Everhope Oncology, and Everbright Health.
About Xponentiate
Xponentiate is a healthcare-focused executive search and talent firm, backed by W Health Ventures and 2070 Health. We place senior leadership across healthtech startups, hospitals, and healthcare VCs, drawing on a network of 250,000+ healthcare professionals. As the firm scales, business development is moving from a founder-led activity to a dedicated function - and this role is the person who builds and owns it.
About the Role
The Business Development Manager owns Xponentiates BD function end to end - from building and running the outbound engine that generates pipeline, through to pitching, negotiating, and closing new search mandates. This is not a role plugged into someone elses process. You build the machine, run it, and are accountable for what it produces in signed mandates and revenue.
You will work closely with the founder and the research and delivery teams, but the origination motion - who to target, how to reach them, and how to close them - is yours to design and run.
What the Role Owns
  • Outbound infrastructure. Owning lead sourcing (Apollo), cold email infrastructure and deliverability (via platforms such as Instantly), and list-building against defined ICPs - healthtech founders, hospital CHROs, and healthcare VCs, across verticals such as fertility, cardiology, biotech, dermatology, and clinical trials.
  • Pipeline generation. Running multi-touch outbound sequences across email and LinkedIn that convert cold contacts into qualified conversations.
  • Full-cycle selling. Pitching Xponentiates services, leading client meetings and presentations, and negotiating commercial terms on retained and engaged search mandates through to signature.
  • Client relationships. Building and maintaining relationships with CXOs, CHROs, Talent Acquisition heads, founders, and healthcare VCs, including within the 2070 Health and W Health Ventures portfolio.
  • Delivery handoff. Working closely with the research and delivery team once a mandate is signed, to ensure a clean handover and protect the relationship through execution.
  • Pipeline reporting. Maintaining an accurate CRM (e.g. Airtable), forecasting, and reporting business performance to leadership.
Working with AI Tools
This role is expected to use AI tools as a default part of the workflow, not as an occasional add-on. That includes using LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT for account research and personalized outreach rather than generic templates, and using AI features inside outbound and CRM tools to speed up list-building, enrichment, and reporting.
Scope of Work
The role covers two areas, introduced in sequence as the function matures.
  • New mandate acquisition, as the starting point. Building and running the outbound engine, prospecting healthtech founders and hospital CHROs, and closing new client mandates for Xponentiates core executive search business.
  • Portfolio and investor network expansion, at a later stage. Deepening relationships across the 2070 Health and W Health Ventures portfolio to generate repeat and referred mandates.
Working Model
This is a build-and-run role rather than a seat in an existing playbook. Expect direct access to leadership, ownership of the function from day one, and accountability measured against pipeline built and mandates closed rather than daily activity.
Growth Path
This starts as a single-owner function: you build it, you run it, you close on it. As pipeline and signed mandates scale, the role is expected to grow into building and leading Xponentiates business development team.
  • 4-7 years of experience in business development or sales, ideally within executive search, recruitment/staffing, or another B2B services business with a comparable sales cycle.
  • A proven track record of originating and closing new client relationships, not only managing inbound or existing accounts.
  • Comfort owning outbound infrastructure directly (tools such as Apollo, Instantly or Smartlead, LinkedIn, and a CRM such as Airtable or HubSpot), or the ability to learn and run it hands-on rather than delegate it.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in your day-to-day work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to pitch confidently to CXOs, founders, and investors.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior exposure to healthcare, healthtech, or life sciences clients.
  • Experience selling into venture-backed or founder-led organizations.
  • Familiarity with retained or engaged executive search commercial models.
This Role Is Not a Fit If
  • You have only worked in a purely client-servicing or delivery role, with no origination or closing experience.
  • You need an established playbook and a built-out team in place before you can operate.
  • You are looking for a narrow, single-channel role - only outbound, or only closing - rather than owning the full function.

Job Summary

Senior DevEx Engineer - Location: Hyderabad

We are growing our Platform Engineering organization with a Senior Developer Experience (DevEx) Engineer who will help us make engineering teams faster, happier, and more productive. Our Platform Engineering team brings together engineers who care deeply about the day-to-day experience of writing, building, testing, and shipping software, all working toward a common mission: removing friction so product engineers can focus on building value for our organization and its customers.

In this role, you will be responsible for the tools, platforms, and workflows that developers rely on every day from local development environments and build systems to CI/CD pipelines and self-service infrastructure. You will work fluently across multiple application stacks, understanding how each is built, tested, and deployed, and use that understanding to design golden paths that work for everyone. You will also measure what matters, turning developer feedback and engineering signals into a clear picture of where friction lives and what to fix next.

This is a high-impact position for someone who thrives at the intersection of platform engineering, build/release tooling, and developer productivity research.

Responsibilities

Internal Developer Platform Self-Service Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and maintain self-service infrastructure and golden paths that let engineers provision environments, services, and pipelines without manual hand-offs.

CI/CD Build Systems

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) that are fast, reliable, and easy for teams to adopt across a range of application stacks.
  • Improve build performance, caching, and dependency management across Node.js, Go, Python, .NET, and other stacks in use.
  • Define and evolve infrastructure-as-code standards (e.g., Terraform) to support consistent, repeatable environment and pipeline provisioning.

Local Developer Environment Tooling

  • Build and maintain tooling, CLIs, and environment configurations that streamline local setup, onboarding, and day-to-day inner-loop development.
  • Reduce environment drift and works on my machine issues by improving parity between local, CI, and production environments.
  • Evaluate and roll out developer tooling (IDE integrations, dev containers, linters, code generators) that meaningfully improve daily workflows.

DevEx Measurement Productivity Research

  • Define and track developer experience and productivity metrics (e.g., DORA, SPACE) to identify friction points across the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Run developer surveys, interviews, and workflow audits to surface pain points, then translate findings into a prioritized improvement roadmap.
  • Build dashboards and reports that give engineering leadership visibility into developer experience trends over time.
  • Partner with engineering teams across different application stacks (Node.js, Go, Python, .NET, and others) to understand their build tools, dependency ecosystems, and design patterns, and tailor platform solutions accordingly.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, developer experience, or a closely related technical domain.
  • Strong, hands-on understanding of multiple application stacks such as Node.js, Go, Python, and .NET including their build tools, dependency management, and common design patterns.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as GitHub Actions (or comparable tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI).
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code, particularly Terraform, for provisioning environments and platform infrastructure.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid scripting and automation skills, and the ability to build internal tools and CLIs that other engineers rely on daily.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across many engineering teams with differing stacks, priorities, and levels of platform maturity.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI tools, agents, or agent harnesses e.g., developing custom coding agents, agentic workflows, or integrating LLM-based tooling into developer or platform workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience defining or tracking developer productivity frameworks such as DORA metrics or SPACE.
  • Familiarity with internal developer platform frameworks or portals (e.g., Backstage or similar).
  • Exposure to observability tooling (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) as it relates to build and pipeline health.
  • Experience running structured developer experience research surveys, interviews, or workflow audits and turning results into a roadmap.

Personal Traits

  • Idea-driven, you regularly bring your own ideas to the table rather than waiting to be told what to build.
  • Motivated by hard, ambiguous problems, you're energized by the challenge of making developer experience meaningfully better, not just maintaining what already exists.
  • Driven by the problem, not the tool, you start from the friction developers actually feel and reach for whatever solves it, rather than building tooling for the sake of building tooling.

The Field Marketing Manager, India will report to the Director of Field Marketing, Asia Pacific / Middle East.

  • Execute field marketing programs across India s defense, Ministry of Defence, Armed Forces, DRDO, and strategic aerospace accounts, aligned with regional Go-to-Market priorities.
  • Support the development and execution of account-based marketing strategies for priority India-based government and defense accounts, helping map buying centers and coordinate multi-touch engagement across events, executive briefings, targeted campaigns, and customer programs.
  • Develop a strong understanding of India s defense procurement environment, acquisition cycles, and stakeholder landscape, using that knowledge to inform effective marketing programs.

  • Build and execute programs within Marketo, including campaign flows, audience segmentation, nurture programs, and performance reporting.
  • Track and report field marketing performance against KPIs including account engagement, stakeholder engagement, campaign participation, opportunity influence, pipeline contribution, and deal acceleration.
  • Manage event and program logistics, agencies, vendors, and other external partners to ensure high-quality and efficient execution.
