  • Partner with compliance and GRC teams to confirm that required security events are logged, retained, monitored, and available to support control and audit requirements.

  • Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources from cloud, infrastructure, network, identity, endpoint, application, and security platforms.
  • Working knowledge of AWS security and logging sources, including services such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs, Route 53, EKS, and EC2.
  • Experience troubleshooting collectors, APIs, event streams, parsers, field mappings, normalization, and ingestion pipelines.
  • Ability to translate threat intelligence, incident findings, and technical changes into logging and detection requirements.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience working with MSSPs or external security operations teams.
  • Experience supporting logging and detection in a SaaS, cloud, or Kubernetes-based environment.
  • Experience with detection-as-code, version control, scripting, APIs, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar automation tools.

descriptionFromApi:
What we need to see
  • A reel, and then the pieces whole. The reel gets you the meeting. Well watch full films to see whether you can hold a structure
  • One thing where the edit is clearly the reason it works. Not the casting, not the location. The cut
  • Range: something funny, something quiet. Comedy timing and restraint are both editing skills and most people only have one
  • Volume work too. Show us a social cutdown youre not embarrassed by
  • Tell us about a fight you lost. A note you disagreed with, made anyway, and what you think now
Tools: Premiere or Resolve fluent, After Effects working. Resolve grading and Audition/Pro Tools are advantages, not requirements.

What you wont get here
  • An assistant editor. Youre logging your own rushes
  • A finished brief. Youll sometimes get rushes and a vague idea and be expected to find the video in there
  • Distance from the client. Youll be in the room, and youll be asked to make changes you disagree with. Sometimes youll win that argument

What you will get
  • A machine that doesnt make you wait for it, and storage that works.
  • Involvement before the shoot youll see boards and get to say "that wont cut" while its still cheap to fix

The one-line version: the film is made twice. Once on the shoot, and once by you - and the second one is the one people see.
What this is
Youre not a pair of hands on a timeline. Youre the last person who gets to have an opinion about the work before it goes out, and often the only one still looking at it with fresh eyes.
Some of what you cut will be craft: brand films, TVCs, long-form, things that get three weeks and deserve them. Some of it will be volume: reels, cutdowns, fourteen aspect ratios of the same thirty seconds. Both are the job. If you only want one, tell us which in your first email and well be honest about the ratio here, its roughly [40]% craft, [60]% volume.
The assembly
The part nobody puts in a showreel and everybody whos good is obsessive about.
  • Ingest, organise, name things properly. Your project files will be opened by someone else at 11pm and they should be able to find everything
  • Watch all the rushes. All of them. The take everyone dismissed on set is frequently the one if you still dont find what you are looking for, source it from stock or generate in AI.
  • Build selects that let a director see options, not just your preferred answer
The cut
  • Find the rhythm. Know when a beat needs two extra frames and be able to say why
  • Choose performance over polish. A slightly soft take with a real reaction beats a perfect one thats dead
  • Kill the shot everyone loves if its slowing the video down. Then be prepared to defend that in the room
  • Cut for the platform honestly, the first 1.5 seconds of a reel and the first 8 seconds of a YouTube pre-roll are different problems and you know both
  • Work with sound from the first assembly, not as a finishing step. Most bad cuts are sound problems
The finish
  • Sound design and mix at least to a good rough. Music selection with actual taste youll be pulling from libraries and making them not sound like libraries
  • Titles, supers, basic motion. After Effects fluency expected
  • Grade at least to a decent look; handle the handoff cleanly when it goes to a colourist
  • Subtitles and captions, done properly, because most of the audience is watching on mute
The delivery
The tax on every job. Its real and its yours.
  • Versions, ratios, durations, platform specs, legal supers, regional cuts
  • File management that survives a client coming back in four months asking for a change
  • Get it out on time without the last hour undoing the previous three weeks

title: Data Curation Engineer
jobDescription:
Flam is building the next generation of interactive media through its content format. We are an AI-native technology company transforming how brands and consumers interact through immersive, interactive content. Our technology enables rich, app-less experiences that can be launched instantly on smartphones, creating a fundamentally different way for brands to engage consumers. We are backed by leading investors and already work with some of the worlds largest brands. We are now building Flicks, our interactive media format for the US market.

About the role

Every model we ship at Flam is bounded by the data that trained it, and every eval number we report is only as trustworthy as the eval set behind it. This role owns both. You will build and run the data layer underneath our LLM Falcon, our TTS system Finesse). That means text, audio, and video, cleaned, deduplicated,filtered,labelled, synthetically generated where real data doesnt exist, and versioned so that six months from now we can say exactly what went into a checkpoint. This is an engineering role. You will write Python every day. It is not an annotation or labelling-management position, though you will design annotation guidelines and quality-check what comes back.

What youll do

  • Build ingestion and cleaning pipelines at scale - deduplication (exact, near-dup, semantic), quality filtering with classifier-based scoring, PII stripping,language identification, format normalization.
  • Generate synthetic data where real data is scarce or expensive: LLM generated instruction and preference data, code-mixed Indic text, rendered scenes for image models, augmented audio for speech models.
  • Curate multilingual and code-mixed Indic corpora. A large part of our differentiation is Indic-language quality, and a large part of that comes down to data hygiene most pipelines get wrong.
  • Build and maintain evaluation sets. Design them so they measure what we think they measure, keep them uncontaminated, and version them properly
  • Handle multimodal data - audio segmentation and transcript alignment for TTS/ASR, face and video preprocessing for avatar training, image-caption pair curation.
  • Own data provenance and versioning. Which files, which filters, which version, which run. This should be answerable in one command, not one afternoon. Write annotation guidelines and audit annotation quality when human labelling is in the loop.

What were looking for

  • Strong Python. You are comfortable processing datasets far larger than memory, and you know when to reach for a database instead of a script.
  • Practical data engineering fundamentals - streaming, chunking, parallelism, checkpointing long jobs, handling malformed input without losing the run.
  • Familiarity with the modern data formats and tooling of ML Parquet,WebDataset, HuggingFace Datasets, object storage S3/GCS/R2.
  • Genuine care about data quality. You should find it uncomfortable when a dataset has duplicates in it.
  • Enough ML understanding to know how a data decision propagates into model behaviour - why dedup matters, why eval contamination invalidates a benchmark, what a bad filter does to a distributions tails.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience curating training data for LLMs, speech models, or image/video models specifically.
  • Working knowledge of embeddings and vector search for semantic deduplication and retrieval FAISS, Milvus, or similar).
  • Native or near-native fluency in one or more Indian languages, with the ability to judge quality in it - this is a real asset here, not a checkbox.
  • Audio or video processing experience (ffmpeg, torchaudio, forced alignment).
  • Synthetic data generation using LLMs, or 3D rendering pipelines Blender, Unreal) for visual data.

Not required

  • A degree in ML.
  • Prior model training experience.
  • Experience with our exact toolchain.

Why this role matters

At most companies, data work is what gets handed to whoever is available. Here its a named role with a named owner, because our model quality is directly downstream of it. Youll work alongside the engineers training the models, and youll see your filtering decisions show up in benchmark numbers within the same quarter. If you want to move into model training over time, this is a strong path into it and well support that.

You will serve as the bridge between Development, QA, and Product Management - ensuring that complex storage stacks are delivered with high quality and predictable cadences.

Unlike traditional project-based release management, this role demands deep hands-on expertise across CI/CD orchestration, codeline management, system-level triaging, fleet operations, and the engineering rigor required for data-critical products. Partner with product and infrastructure teams to find issues earlier in the pipeline, improve signal quality, and reduce manual toil in triage and merge operations.

Requirements

  • CI/CD Mastery: Expert knowledge of orchestration tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Systems Thinking: Deep understanding of the full SDLC, including branching strategies (Gitflow/Trunk-based development) and versioning.
  • Scripting/Automation: Proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automating release tasks and data analysis.
  • Branching/Codeline management: Strong git and codeline intuition, with an appreciation for merge quality, guardrails, and release-safe integration workflows.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

You will build the AI features that make those products work and you will build them for production, not for a demo.

That means retrieval systems over large document corpora that arrive as inconsistent PDFs, scans and HTML. Extraction pipelines that pull structured fields out of documents that were never designed to be parsed. Classification against real-world taxonomies. Agentic workflows where they genuinely beat a deterministic pipeline. And, underneath all of it, the evaluation harnesses that tell you whether any of it actually works.

Because you will work across several ventures rather than one, you will also be one of the people deciding what gets built once and reused everywhere. That leverage is the most interesting part of the job.

This is an engineering role. Most of your time goes into services, pipelines, data plumbing, tests and evals. The model is a component, not the job.

Responsibilities

  • Take AI features from vague problem statement through to specified, built, evaluated and deployed.
  • Build RAG systems end to end ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, grounding and citation over messy documents at scale.
  • Build extraction and classification pipelines that map unstructured documents onto structured taxonomies, and handle the long tail where documents dont cooperate.
  • Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets and regression suites, and feed real production failures back into them.
  • Own cost and latency as first-class constraints: model routing, caching, batching, context economy, fallbacks when a provider degrades.
  • Ship with real observability tracing, quality dashboards, spend tracking.
  • Identify whats common across ventures and build it once, properly, with documentation.

What we're looking for

  • 2-4 years of professional software engineering, including at least a year building with language models. Strong engineering fundamentals matter more here than exotic ML knowledge.
  • Youve shipped an LLM-powered feature to real users in production and can describe it end to end-the data flow, the failure handling, what it cost, what broke after launch, and what you changed. Notebooks, demos and course projects dont count for this one.
  • Evaluation discipline: you can explain how you knew a system was good enough to ship, and how you measured whether changes made it better. The dataset, the metric, the baseline.
  • Strong Python, plus real production practice: version control, testing, CI, containers, and operating a service you wrote. Comfort with SQL and a cloud platform.
  • Practical command of the applied LLM toolkit: frontier model APIs, structured output, tool calling, embeddings and vector search, reranking, context management. We care that you understand the mechanics, not that youve used a particular framework.
  • Judgment about when not to use a model: you can explain why you replaced an LLM call with a regex, a database query or a smaller model and why that was right.
  • Clear written and spoken English.

Not required

  • A PhD or publications were not building novel models.
  • Experience training large models from scratch.
  • A specific degree. We care about what youve shipped.

Why join

  • Real production AI, at volume, on problems that dont have textbook answers.
  • Breadth: youll work across several ventures rather than one narrow surface, and what you build gets reused.
  • A domain with genuinely hard document problems: procurement data is as messy as it gets.
  • Direct access to engineering leadership, short feedback loops, freedom in technical choices.
  • The field moves quarterly and youre expected to keep up on company time evaluating whats new is part of the job, not something you do at midnight.

Flam is building the next generation of interactive media through its content format. We are an AI-native technology company transforming how brands and consumers interact through immersive, interactive content. Flam builds AI-native tools for interactive brand content. Were hiring a visual designer who treats generative tooling as a production pipeline, and who thinks in systems rather than one-offs.

  • Design so that one asset becomes many - parameterised, adaptable, consistent
  • Build and refine AI-assisted production workflows for image, video and 3D

  • Real fluency with generative tools, plus a clear-eyed view of where they break
  • Motion and interaction sensibility. This work is experienced, not just viewed
  • Systems instinct and speed

  • figma

This isn t just another remote opportunity - it s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
About the Role
As a Business Development Representative, you will be a key part of the sales team, responsible for generating a strong pipeline through focused outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will research and engage potential customers, qualify opportunities, and ensure promising leads are smoothly passed across for further development.
This is a fast-paced, high-activity role centred around personalised outreach, pipeline creation, and accurate CRM management. You will work alongside the wider sales team to develop account strategies and messaging, test and improve outbound approaches, and contribute to business growth through consistent execution and strong commercial judgement.
Responsibilities
  • Lead LinkedIn outbound campaigns through targeted and personalised engagement with CTOs, Heads of Engineering and other senior decision-makers.
  • Generate a strong, qualified pipeline by identifying ICP-aligned accounts, engaging key prospects and securing qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Work closely with UK Account Executives to align on account strategy and messaging, while ensuring a smooth and effective handover of qualified opportunities.

  • Consistently deliver against activity and performance targets through structured daily outreach, strong engagement rates and qualified meeting generation.
  • Keep HubSpot records accurate and current while managing outbound sequences across platforms such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Regularly experiment with and refine outbound messaging and sequences to increase response rates and improve conversion outcomes.
Requirements

About Us

Visit Health is a pioneering health-tech platform, founded by four BITS Pilani alumni, to democratize healthcare. Launched as a telemedicine platform in 2016, Visit Health has today grown into an all-in-one healthcare platform providing preventive, primary, holistic wellness, condition management, and care services to 80 lakh+ Indians through 80,000+ doctors, 8,500+ diagnostic centres, 5,500+ pharmacies.

Our Core Offerings

Primary OPD Benefits: Seamless OPD services right from doctor consults to medicine delivery, reducing out-of-pocket expenses through cashless OPD benefits.
Preventive Health Management: Health check-ups vaccines to fitness gym membership for preventive proactive healthcare management.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): 360-degree wellness ecosystem combining mental, financial, and legal consultations/expert-led advice, along with a mood tracker for a balanced work-life experience.
Condition Management Care Programs: Comprehensive programs for chronic condition management and specialized care programs for pregnancy, women, and elders.

Founding Team

The founding team - Chetan Anand, Anurag Prasad, Vaibhav Singh, and Shashvat Tripathi - established Visit Health to bridge the healthcare gap in India. Driven by their experiences with limited healthcare access in Pilani, they have built Visit Health into a platform that advocates quality, accessible, and affordable healthcare for everyone.

What Sets Us Apart

Designed for Evolving Healthcare: Unlike standalone wellness platforms, Visit Health combines OPD teleconsultation, diagnostics pharmacy, annual health checkups, mental wellness EAP, fitness gym memberships, gamified challenges, chronic condition management, cashless reimbursement journeys, and a rewards ecosystem engagement programs into one digital platform meeting all evolving demands.
Tech-led Customization Integration: Visit Health s deeply integrated technology ecosystem, which offers a modular, highly customizable implementation framework that integrates seamlessly with existing enterprise systems. Our implementation capabilities include HRMS integrations, Single Sign-On (SSO), API-based insurer TPA integrations, employer-specific benefit configurations real-time reporting dashboards. Our platform supports iOS, Android, and Progressive Web App experiences. This enables organizations to launch highly personalized healthcare ecosystems aligned to their workforce demographics objectives.
Operational Quickness: Visit Health has shown excellent operational capabilities with 99% of claims processed within 24 hours, 90% of reimbursements settled within 3 working days, instant consultation booking confirmations, report delivery within 24-72 hours, and medicine delivery within 1-24 hours.
Robust Network: Visit Health s robust and ever-growing healthcare network with 80,000+ doctors, 25,000+ hospitals clinics, 8,500+ diagnostic centers, and 5,500+ pharmacies, which has enabled organizations to deliver consistent healthcare access to distributed and hybrid users across India.

Key Milestones Achievements

Expanding Primary Care Access: Serving over 80 lakh+ users with 16L+ health checkups, 20L+ teleconsultations, and 2L+ pharmacy orders annually.
Strategic Partnerships: Partnered with 500+ corporates, 7000+ SMEs, and 22+ leading insurers.
Awards Recognition: Modi Prix Galien India award by the Galien Foundation, Institutional Excellence in Well-being award by BW Well-being World. Recognized as Top Healthtech AI Startups to Know by Digital Health News, Select 200 companies with Global business potential by D-Globalist Forbes India, and Profitable Indicorn Startup by Titan Capital.
Funding Success: Secured $40 million in investments and backed by leading investors like Docprime Technologies Zydus Lifesciences.

Future Vision

Visit Health aims to further strengthen India s primary care infrastructure, expand its corporate and insurer partnerships, and introduce more advanced and accessible health solutions. With a focus on universal health coverage, we re committed to making healthcare accessible affordable to lead healthier lives.
Visit Health - Empowering workforce their families with accessible, affordable, and impactful healthcare.

About the Role

We are looking for a Clinical Research Medical Intelligence Lead to build and strengthen the clinical intelligence layer across Visit Healths healthcare products and services.
This is a research-oriented, clinically rigorous role for someone who can independently evaluate medical evidence, translate it into clinical frameworks and decision logic, and work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, and healthcare teams to operationalize it at scale.
The role will involve developing and validating clinical parameters, medical formulas, risk scores, thresholds, assessment frameworks, recommendation logic, and clinical protocols across Health Risk Assessments, Smart Health Reports, disease profiles, preventive health programs, and condition-management journeys.
The person will also play a key role in establishing clinical quality, governance, documentation, and research processes, with the opportunity to build and eventually lead the Clinical Research Medical Intelligence function.

Location
Noida / Bangalore

Experience

3-7 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

  • Clinical or Medical Research
  • Medical / Scientific Writing
  • Digital Health / Health-tech
  • Preventive Healthcare
  • Clinical Product Development
  • Healthcare Consulting
  • Clinical Quality or Governance
  • Epidemiology / Public Health
  • Evidence-based healthcare
Candidates with strong clinical research, analytical, and medical intelligence capabilities may also be considered even if their experience does not fit neatly into the above categories.

Mandatory Qualification
  • MBBS
Preferred

  • Experience in clinical research, medical writing, scientific research, or systematic literature review
  • Strong understanding of clinical guidelines and evidence-based medicine
  • Experience working with clinical protocols, risk assessment frameworks, or healthcare products
  • Certification or additional qualification in Clinical Research, Epidemiology, Public Health, Digital Health, Health Informatics, or Healthcare Analytics
  • Masters degree / MBA in Healthcare Management, Public Health, or a related field is an advantage
Key Responsibilities 1. Clinical Research Evidence Validation
  • Conduct structured medical and scientific research using peer-reviewed literature, clinical guidelines, and other credible evidence-based sources.
  • Evaluate the quality, relevance, and applicability of clinical evidence.
  • Build evidence summaries and recommendations to support healthcare products and clinical frameworks.
  • Continuously review emerging clinical evidence and assess its relevance to existing products and protocols.
2. Clinical Framework Risk Model Development
  • Develop and validate clinical parameters, biomarkers, formulas, indices, scoring systems, thresholds, and risk-assessment methodologies.
  • Define clinical interpretation and risk-stratification logic for different health conditions and patient profiles.
  • Ensure that clinical frameworks are scientifically sound, internally consistent, and practical to implement at scale.
3. Health Risk Assessment Medical Intelligence
  • Develop and enhance clinical frameworks for Health Risk Assessments, Smart Health Reports, disease profiles, and condition-management journeys.
  • Define interpretation logic, risk categories, recommendations, escalation criteria, and appropriate clinical next steps.
  • Translate medical evidence into structured and actionable health insights for users.
4. Clinical Algorithms Care Recommendations
  • Develop evidence-based decision frameworks and algorithms for:
    • Preventive care
    • Health screening and diagnostics
    • Specialist referrals
    • Lifestyle interventions
    • Health coaching
    • Condition management
    • Personalized care journeys
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to translate clinical logic into scalable product requirements and rules.
5. Medical Scientific Writing
  • Create and maintain clinical research documents, evidence summaries, protocols, guidelines, clinical content, and medical documentation.
  • Convert complex clinical concepts into clear, structured, and actionable documentation for both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain a structured clinical knowledge repository.
6. Clinical Quality, Governance SOPs
  • Contribute to the development of clinical quality standards and governance frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, documentation standards, clinical protocols, audit mechanisms, and quality-control processes.
  • Support doctor evaluation frameworks and clinical quality reviews to ensure consistency across healthcare services.
  • Identify gaps in clinical processes and recommend improvements.
7. Cross-Functional Product Collaboration
  • Partner closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Doctors, Health Coaches, Diagnostics, and Operations teams.
  • Translate clinical requirements into clear, implementable frameworks and product specifications.
  • Review product features and healthcare journeys from a clinical accuracy, safety, and evidence perspective.
  • Balance clinical rigor with usability, scalability, and real-world implementation.
8. Build the Clinical Research Medical Intelligence Function
  • Establish structured processes for clinical research, evidence review, validation, documentation, and governance.
  • Build reusable clinical frameworks, repositories, templates, and review mechanisms.
  • Take ownership of strengthening the Clinical Research Medical Intelligence capability as the function scales.
  • Over time, contribute to building the team, operating model, and standards for the function.

  • Strong foundation in clinical medicine and evidence-based healthcare.

  • Comfortable working with clinical parameters, biomarkers, formulas, indices, thresholds, and risk scores.

At Decisions, we help organizations make work easier through intelligent process orchestration. Our platform brings workflows, rules, approvals, and AI together so teams can simplify complex processes, move faster, and focus on the work that matters most. Behind that platform is a team of curious, collaborative people who take ownership, support one another, and care about creating real impact for our customers. If you re excited by meaningful work, smart teammates, and opportunities to grow, Decisions could be a great place for you.

About the Role

Decisions is a PE-backed enterprise automation platform operating across multiple geographies. Our Corporate FPA team in Hyderabad is the central planning and analysis function for the whole company. It owns the consolidated budget and forecast, month-end management reporting, the company financial model, and the KPI frameworks that the CFO, CEO, Board, and our PE sponsor rely on to steer the business.
The Analyst/Senior FPA Analyst is the teams analytical anchor. You will own the monthly reporting and BVA cycle, run key workstreams within the annual operating plan (AOP), rolling forecasts, and long-range plan, and act as the corporate finance partner for one or more business functions. You are expected to move beyond producing numbers to explaining them - identifying what changed, why it matters, and what leadership should do about it.
The role is deeply cross-functional. You will work with the Controller and Accounting team on close, with RevOps and GTM Finance on the companys revenue number, with HR on headcount, and with department heads across India and the US on their budgets. You will also coach the Interns and Junio Analysts and own projects that build the source-of-truth reports and financial model underpinning the 2027 plan.

What You ll Own

Corporate FPA connects every function to the company plan. In this role you will collaborate regularly with:
  • Head of FPA - monthly commentary, Board and sponsor materials, and planning decisions.
  • Controller and Accounting - close calendar, accruals, intercompany eliminations, FX, audit and investor requests.
  • Revenue Operations - Salesforce data governance, pipeline-to-forecast alignment, and KPI definitions.
  • People / HR - headcount planning, hiring approvals, and compensation modelling for AOP and forecasts.
  • One or Few Department heads e.g. Engineering, Product, IT, Cloud, Customer Success, and GA - budget reviews, investment cases, and vendor spending.
  • US-based leadership and peers - several days a week of overlapping hours for reviews, forecasts, and decisions.

Core responsibilities
1. Monthly management reporting and variance analysis
  • Own the month-end and quarter-end FPA close: consolidated PL, departmental BVA, headcount.
  • Write CFO-ready variance commentary that explains drivers, quantifies impact, and recommends actions.
  • Prepare and quality-check PowerPoint and Excel materials for the Monthly Business Review, Board of Directors, and PE sponsor reporting cycles.
2. Budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling
  • Lead assigned workstreams in the AOP: headcount planning, opex budgets, and department-level targets, working directly with budget owners.
  • Maintain and enhance the driver-based corporate financial model; build scenarios for leadership on pricing, hiring, and investment decisions.
  • Own the rolling forecast for assigned areas, track forecast accuracy over time, and support long-range planning.
3. SaaS metrics, KPI framework, and benchmarking
  • Support the calculation and governance of core SaaS KPIs - ARR, NRR/GDR, bookings, CAC, payback, EBITDA, and Rule of 40 - with documented definitions.
  • Maintain the weekly and monthly KPI tracker; reconcile Salesforce and finance data so that GTM and Finance report a single number.
  • Benchmark Decisions against public and private SaaS peers on growth, efficiency, and margin metrics to inform targets.
  • Flag inconsistencies, data breaks, and definitional drift before they reach leadership forums.
4. Cross-team collaboration and business partnering
  • Serve as corporate finance partner for one or more functions (for example Engineering, Product, Customer Success, IT, Cloud, or GA): monthly reviews, headcount requests, vendor spend, and investment cases.
  • Run a regular cadence with Accounting to align on close timing, accruals, and reclasses, and with RevOps on data governance for revenue metrics.
  • Translate business questions into analysis and present findings clearly to non-finance stakeholders; challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Support vendor consolidation and cost optimization initiatives with spend analytics and savings tracking, working with Accounting and Systems.
5. Reporting infrastructure and projects
  • Design and build source-of-truth reports in Excel and Power BI; drive the migration of recurring MIS to a stable, documented report library.
  • Partner with Accounting and Systems on the chart of accounts redesign, and Join consolidation.
  • Own medium-sized FPA projects end to end - scope, stakeholders, timeline, delivery - and report progress to the Head of FPA.
  • Automate recurring work using Power BI, structured Excel, and AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot and raise the teams standards for documentation.
6. Team leadership
  • Coach and review the work of the Interns, and Junior FPA Analyst ; act as onboarding buddy for new team members.
  • Own the reporting calendar and distribute recurring work so that no single person is a point of failure.

What You Bring

Qualifications
Required
  • 2-6 years of progressive FPA or corporate finance experience, ideally in SaaS, technology, or a PE-backed company.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a month-end reporting or BVA cycle , including writing variance commentary for senior leadership.
  • Hands-on financial modelling experience : driver-based models, scenario analysis, and three-statement fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR/GDR, CAC, payback, burn) and how they are derived from CRM and finance data.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint ; experience with at least one planning tool (Adaptive, Anaplan or similar) and one BI tool (Power BI or Tableau).
  • Track record of working across functions - with Accounting, Sales/RevOps, HR, or operations teams - to deliver a shared outcome.
  • Strong communication skills; comfortable presenting to directors and VPs and challenging assumptions constructively.
  • Able to work overlapping US hours several days a week .
Preferred
  • MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent.
  • Experience in a multi-entity consolidated environment with intercompany eliminations and FX.
  • Exposure to Board or investor reporting for a PE-backed company.
  • Hands-on experience with
  • Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, and Joiin (or comparable consolidation tools)
  • Salesforce and QuickBooks (or NetSuite)
  • Power BI with DAX, or SQL
  • AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Microsoft Copilot for analysis, drafting, and automation
  • Prior experience coaching or reviewing the work of junior analysts.

Bonus Points

What success looks like
  • Within 30 days: has mapped the end-to-end month-end reporting cycle, taken ownership of the recurring reports in scope with zero tie-out errors, and met every cross-functional partner they support.
  • Within 60 days: has taken over the monthly BVA cycle for assigned departments, delivered commentary on schedule, and established working relationships with Accounting, RevOps, and assigned budget owners.
  • Within 90 days: has a review cadence running with at least one business partner and has documented the KPI definitions they own.
Reporting and working arrangement

The role is based in our Hyderabad office and reports to the Director of Finance Head of FPA. It has dotted-line coaching responsibility for the FPA Analyst. Compensation is competitive for the Hyderabad market and will be shared with shortlisted candidates.
Decisions is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for capability, curiosity, and integrity, and we build finance careers, not just finance roles.

Benefits Perks
We know people do their best work when they feel supported. That s why we offer benefits and perks that help our employees take care of themselves, stay connected, and continue growing in and outside of work.

Job Description
Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Lead with strong expertise in CRM data integration, analytics solutions, enterprise data architecture and data governance to lead the implementation of HubSpot data into the IFS Enterprise Data Lake. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable data solutions, enabling trusted analytics across sales, marketing, customer engagement and business performance domains.
This role requires strong experience in HubSpot data structures, data modeling, data integration, metadata management, data quality and analytics platforms. The Data lead will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, marketing and sales teams, data engineers, analytics teams and enterprise architect to deliver secure, scalable and high-quality data solutions that support reporting, dashboarding and advanced analytics initiatives.
The Senior Data lead will design and be responsible for the implementation of scalable, integrated data solutions across the L2O landscape. Working closely with Systems Integrators (SI), IFS, Data Analytics teams, PMO and Sales stakeholders, the role ensures optimal data integration architecture, high data quality and ensure minimal impact on the data model.
The engagement will look at the existing data models built from THOR/ IFS Cloud provide a least minimal impact solution with data sourced from Hubspot. It will provide data leadership across the full L2O landscape, including HubSpot, DealHub, THOR/IFS Cloud, Power BI / Microsoft Fabric and related data sources. The Senior Data Architect will provide documentation and support the data engineer with the implementation.
The successful candidate will work under the direction and guidance of the Senior Director, Data Analytics, who will provide strategic oversight, business priorities and ensure successful project delivery. The role will also work closely with the Senior Technical Manager, Data Analytics on solution architecture, technical design, implementation planning, data integration activities and adherence to enterprise data standards. This collaborative leadership structure is intended to provide clear direction, remove delivery obstacles and enable the Data Lead to focus on delivering a successful HubSpot analytics solution within the IFS Enterprise Data Lake.
Key L2O Scope Covered by the Role
Architect Design Hubspot data for Analytics into Data lake
  • Assess and document HubSpot data sources, entities, relationships and business requirements for analytics consumption.
  • Design scalable data architecture and ingestion frameworks to extract HubSpot data into the enterprise data lake.
  • Define data models, schemas and storage strategies to support reporting, analytics and downstream impact.
  • Establish data mapping, transformation and enrichment rules to align HubSpot data with enterprise standards.
  • Implement data quality, validation and governance controls to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance.
  • Design incremental data integration patterns to support timely analytics and operational reporting.
  • Develop metadata, lineage and documentation standards for HubSpot data assets within the data lake ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analytics teams and data engineers to ensure minimal reporting impact during the transition from the existing CRM platform (THOR/ IFS Cloud) to HubSpot.
  • Optimize data pipelines and storage structures for performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Provide architecture recommendations and best practices for future expansion of customer, marketing, sales and service analytics.
Create Functional Requirement Document (FRD)
  • Conduct stakeholder workshops and requirement gathering sessions to capture business, functional and reporting needs.
  • Document business objectives, scope, assumptions, dependencies and success criteria for the HubSpot analytics solution.
  • Define functional requirements for data ingestion, transformation, storage and consumption within the fabric/ data lake environment.
  • Capture source-to-target mapping requirements, including business rules, data definitions and transformation logic.
  • Document analytical use cases, KPIs, metrics, dashboards and reporting requirements.
  • Define data quality, validation, reconciliation and exception-handling requirements.
  • Capture security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Document user roles, access controls and data consumption requirements for business and technical stakeholders.
  • Develop process flows, data flow diagrams and functional specifications to support implementation.
  • Facilitate requirement reviews, stakeholder sign-off, and change management throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Provide traceability between business requirements, functional requirements and solution design artifacts.
Implementation of Data from HubSpot into IFS enterprise Data Lake
  • Assist the data engineer with configuring and implementing secure data extraction processes from HubSpot using APIs, connectors or integration services.
  • Assist the data engineer with development and deployment of automated data ingestion pipelines to load HubSpot data into the IFS Enterprise Data Lake.
  • Assist the data engineer with Implementation of data transformation, cleansing and standardization processes in accordance with approved business rules and data models.

  • Documentation of ingestion frameworks to extract HubSpot data into the enterprise data lake
  • Document HubSpot data sources, entities, relationships and business requirements for analytics consumption.

  • Document business objectives, scope, assumptions, dependencies and success criteria for the HubSpot analytics solution.
  • Define functional requirements for data ingestion, transformation, storage and consumption within the fabric/ data lake environment.

Data pipelines, data quality dashboards
  • Data pipelines running with incremental data load.
  • Data quality dashboards
  • Data lineage implementation for HubSpot data
  • Data catalogue implementation for HubSpot data
Qualifications
Essential Experience
  • 5-8 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering or enterprise data management.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data platforms.
  • Microsoft Fabric AI Capabilities
  • Azure AI Services
  • Azure Machine Learning
  • Generative AI
  • Strong experience in enterprise data governance and metadata management.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data models and analytics platforms.
  • Strong data management skills
  • Good understanding of Star Schema based framework, Data warehouse and Data Mart and Materialized View
  • Good understanding of database concepts like normalization, joins, changing dimensions etc..
  • Good understanding of relational and non-relational database management systems
  • Experience in CRM, CPQ, sales, commercial, ERP or quote-to-cash / lead-to-order solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, written communication and evidence-based reporting skills.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Systems or equivalent practical experience; fluency in English.
Highly Beneficial Experience
  • Experience with HubSpot, DealHub, Salesforce, Dynamics or similar CRM / sales platforms.
  • Experience with CPQ platforms, quotation/pricing flows, approval workflows and DAR-like governance processes.
  • Experience with ERP integration, preferably IFS Cloud / THOR, SAP, Oracle or NetSuite.
  • Experience with Azure BI technology (Fabric, Synapse, Power BI, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSAS, Purview, OneLake, ADF)
Technical Skills
  • Fabric, Synapse, Power BI, Azure SQL, SSIS, SSAS, Purview, OneLake, ADF
  • Management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Teams or equivalent.
Business and Process Knowledge
  • Lead-to-Order / Lead-to-Cash process concepts.
  • Lead, account, contact, opportunity, quote, contract and order data flows.
  • Data quality and master data dependencies.
Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
  • Lead testing across multiple teams without direct line management authority.
  • Be structured, pragmatic and delivery-focused.
  • Communicate clearly with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Challenge incomplete requirements, unclear ownership and insufficient test evidence.
  • Escalate risks early and professionally.
  • Maintain control under delivery pressure.
  • Separate critical go-live issues from lower-priority improvements.
  • Drive accountability across vendors, IT and business.
  • Build confidence with senior stakeholders through clear reporting and evidence.
  • Operate independently while staying aligned with programme governance.
Education and Certifications
Essential
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Systems or equivalent practical experience.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.
  • Proven experience in test leadership roles.
Highly Beneficial
  • Fabric Data Engineer.

Reuters is seeking a Polling Correspondent to join its global polling team, which produces market-leading forecasts and exclusive stories on economic and financial-market developments across 50 key economies. Reporting to Hari Kishan, Editor In Charge, you will collaborate with colleagues across Reuters globally distributed polling team. You will contribute to regular and ad hoc polls covering central-bank decisions, macroeconomic indicators, inflation, growth, unemployment, foreign exchange, bond yields and equity markets, while helping deliver high-quality journalism that informs a global audience.
Relocation support is available, but the role doesn t require travel.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Support the planning, execution, and analysis of regular and ad hoc Reuters polls on macroeconomic trends, financial markets and central-bank policy, helping ensure timely and reliable results.
  • Monitor economic data releases, market-moving events, and central-bank decisions to identify timely polling opportunities and develop strong story angles.
  • Analyze poll findings alongside relevant economic and market developments to produce accurate, concise and insightful stories for Reuters global audience.

  • Editorial Judgment and Accuracy: Applies sound news judgment and handles economic, market and polling information with care, precision and impartiality.

  • Strong writing, reporting and news judgment, with a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness and impartiality.
  • Interest in, or basic knowledge of, economics, financial markets and central-bank policy.
  • Microsoft Excel - Intermediate proficiency, including the ability to organize, analyze and interpret data using spreadsheets.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles in AWS environments.

  • Strong product sense for rapid iteration and refinement based on data, combined with a collaborative mindset to work closely with engineers, product managers, and security analysts in a fast-paced environment.

Join our values-led organization committed to building a more resilient world with people and planet in mind. Our core values are the foundation that make us successful for ourselves, our customers and the planet.
Job Description
The Role
The Freshservice Developer Administrator owns the configuration, automation, integration, and day-to-day administration of Albemarles enterprise ITSM platform. Following the transition of Service Management from ServiceNow to Freshworks - this role is central to sustaining and scaling the platform across IT and business workspaces (HR, Facilities, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing Engineering, Accounts Payable etc).
The role blends two hats:
  • Administrator - configuring, securing, and maintaining the workspace and account environment so agents have the right access, tools, and workflows to deliver service.
  • Developer - designing, building, testing, and promoting automations within the federated "DEV-to-PROD" governance model, where individual IT teams build in a controlled DEV environment and a central team governs, reviews, and promotes to production.
It supports Albemarles broader strategic direction of Digital Transformation through automation as the foundation for AI-driven processes, including Freshservice as the "front door" to HR and other functions.
Key Skill Set:
Platform Administration
  • Deep hands-on Freshservice administration across both Workspace Admin and Account Admin scopes - branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalog, field/form management, and RBAC (custom roles and permissions).
  • Command of core ITSM modules: Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change (normal/emergency/expedited), Release, Service Request, Asset/ITAM, and Alert Management.
  • CMDB / Configuration Management and Device42 integration (discovery, CI data accuracy, incident/change linkage).
Automation Development
  • Expert in Workflow Automator, Scenario Automations, Supervisor rules, Scheduler, and orchestration/business rules.
  • Ability to build well-structured workflows - triggers, nested conditions, labelled branches, single-action nodes, and error paths for external calls.
Integrations APIs
  • Experience integrating Freshservice with Active Directory / Azure (Entra ID) orchestration via the Freshservice App + PowerShell, Workday Connector (RaaS-based and event-based onboarding/offboarding journeys), UiPath RPA, SAP, MS Exchange, SharePoint Search Connector, and BlueCoat.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, OAuth 2.0 / API-key / Basic auth, webhooks, and custom HTTP-based flows; awareness of Copilot Studio and the Freshservice MCP Server for advanced/AI-driven scenarios.
  • Understanding of AI service agent integration (Aisera) for ticket create/update/close, KB ingestion, and Freddy AI capabilities.
Governance, Knowledge Analytics
  • Analytics, dashboards, KPIs, SLA compliance reporting, and audit-readiness.
  • Comfort operating within a sandbox-first approach - testing new configurations and major updates before syncing to production.
Soft skills
Process standardization mindset, cross-functional collaboration (HR, IT, IAM, Security, Infrastructure), clear documentation, and stakeholder communication.
What will you be doing
Administration Configuration
  • Configure and maintain workspaces (branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalogs, custom fields, forms, and templates) tailored to departmental needs.
  • Manage agents, groups, roles, and RBAC; configure the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for change processes.
  • Administer all Freshservice modules and monitor platform health, troubleshooting performance and proactively addressing risks.
  • Review Freshworks biannual/product release notes, test updates in sandbox, re-activate/republish affected configurations, and communicate changes to agents and end users.
Development Automation
  • Design, build, and test automations in the DEV environment following the naming convention (Module - Trigger - Action), testing every condition branch and failure scenario before submission.
  • Complete pre-work documentation and DEV-to-PROD promotion checklists; submit via Freshservice change requests with test evidence for central-team review.
  • Own and maintain automations post-production across their full lifecycle.
Integrations
  • Build and support integrations for onboarding/offboarding (Workday Freshservice Journeys), user/AD group provisioning, mailbox/distribution-group management, RPA-driven ticket automation, and CMDB sync with Device42.
  • Coordinate with IAM, IT Security, Infrastructure, HRIS, and vendor teams (Freshworks, Infosys, Aisera) to configure and validate integrations securely.
Knowledge, Analytics Continuous Improvement
  • Build meaningful dashboards, KPIs, and SLA/analytics reports; drive process standardization, adoption, and automation opportunities.
  • Configure Announcements for centralized service communication.
Who you are:
Essential
  • 4-7+ years in IT Service Management, with 2+ years hands-on Freshservice administration and/or development (Enterprise plan preferred). Prior ServiceNow experience is a strong plus given the migration context.
  • Demonstrable experience configuring ITIL-aligned processes: Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Request Fulfillment, Knowledge, and Configuration/Asset Management.
  • Proven track record building automations in Workflow Automator (including approvals, multi-step workflows, and external integrations).
  • Scripting/integration experience - PowerShell for AD/Entra orchestration and REST API / OAuth-based integrations (Workday, UiPath, SAP, Exchange, SharePoint).
  • Working knowledge of CMDB/ITAM concepts and tools such as Device42.
Desirable
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification; Freshservice/Freshworks Academy certifications (Fundamentals, Workflow Automator - Getting Started Advanced Logic, SR Catalogue Management, Reporting Audit Logs).
  • Exposure to AI/GenAI service agents (Aisera, Freddy AI, Copilot Studio, MCP Server) and RAG-based knowledge retrieval.
  • Experience operating within a federated/governed automation model with DEV/PROD separation, change-controlled promotions, and central review tiers.
  • Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills in a global, multi-vendor environment.
Benefits of Joining Albemarle
  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.

About Marvell
Marvell s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
Your Team, Your Impact
Marvell is seeking an Infrastructure Security Engineer to drive cyber security best practices across the systems, appliances, and platforms that run Marvells data center and cloud (IaaS/PaaS) environments, along with email security. This role partners closely with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams across each area of the data center, cloud, compute, storage, network, and virtualization to identify risk and drive adoption of stronger technical controls
What You Can Expect
  • Partner with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams spanning compute, storage, network, and virtualization in the data center and cloud environment, as well as the M365/Exchange Online team, to drive cyber security best practices.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the tools and systems used to manage and protect data center and cloud infrastructure (hardening standards, patch and vulnerability management, privileged access, configuration management, cloud security posture tooling) and administer/tune the Proofpoint email security platform.
  • Design and recommend email security architecture and technical controls that reduce phishing, business email compromise, and account takeover risk.
  • Identify and help drive remediation on gaps in baseline security controls across data center, cloud, and email environments, working with system owners to prioritize based on risk.
  • Act as a technical liaison between Security/SecOps and IT Infrastructure, Operations, and Exchange teams, translating security requirements into practical, operationally feasible controls.
  • Work with the SOC as needed to support investigation and response for infrastructure- and email-related security incidents, providing technical context on affected systems.
  • Contribute to metrics and reporting on infrastructure and email security posture, control effectiveness, and residual risk.
What Were Looking For
  • Hands-on experience administering and managing servers running Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems with focus on cyber security hardening and best practices
  • Working knowledge of virtualization platforms (e. g. , VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V).
  • Solid understanding of core network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP) and data center appliances (firewalls, load balancers such as F5, switches/routers)
  • Experience with cloud IaaS/PaaS environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) compute, storage, networking, and identity/access management services.
  • Working knowledge of configuration and patch management tooling (e. g. , SCCM, Ansible, Puppet, Chef) and vulnerability management/scanning platforms (e. g. , Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7).
  • Practical experience with enterprise storage and appliances (e. g. , NetApp, Dell EMC, Pure Storage) and how theyre typically secured and managed.
  • Hands-on experience administering Proofpoint (or a comparable secure email gateway platform such as Mimecast, Abnormal Security, or Microsoft Defender for Office 365) in an enterprise environment is a big plus
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, with deep focus on Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, connectors, authentication protocols).
  • Solid working familiarity of core email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  • Practical understanding of identity infrastructure (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID) and privileged access management (PAM) concepts.
  • Experience with asset discovery/inventory tooling and building compliance reporting or dashboards to track endpoint protection coverage across a large device fleet.
  • Broad cybersecurity fundamentals across a modern enterprise: identity, endpoint, network, and cloud security concepts.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT Engineering, IT Operations, SecOps, SOC, and Security Engineering teams.
  • Ability to translate security requirements into practical guidance for operational teams and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with backup/disaster recovery platforms (e. g. , Veeam, Commvault) and container/Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and SIEM platforms (e. g. , Splunk, XSIAM).
  • Experience in a high-growth or high-visibility organization with an elevated threat profile.
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field. Masters degree preferred.
  • Relevant certifications (e. g. , CISSP, GIAC/GSEC, Proofpoint certifications, cloud security certifications, Azure, AWS and GCP certifications).

title: HR Generalist
jobDescription:
":"
ProCreator is looking for an HR Generalist / People Operations professional to own and drive core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, while helping strengthen people processes, employee experience, policy governance, and hiring coordination.
This role is ideal for someone who is hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable managing day-to-day HR operations independently. The person will play a key role in ensuring smooth onboarding, employee record management, attendance and leave administration, payroll inputs, engagement initiatives, policy execution, and exit formalities. Alongside this, the role will also support recruitment governance and collaborate closely with the recruiter and hiring stakeholders to ensure process adherence and business continuity.
While the role is primarily an individual contributor position, the person may oversee one recruiter and is expected to step into hiring execution when recruitment volumes or business priorities demand it.

Key Responsibilities
1) Core HR Operations
  • Own end-to-end employee lifecycle administration from post-offer handover through onboarding, active employment, and exits
  • Manage employee records, letters, workflows, approvals, and documentation through HR systems, especially Zoho People
  • Handle joining formalities including employment documents, NDA, code of conduct, KYC, bank details, background verification coordination, and induction readiness
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as IT for asset allocation, ID creation, access setup, RFID cards, and other onboarding requirements
  • Administer leave, attendance, holiday calendars, attendance regularizations, special leave creation, and exception handling
  • Provide accurate monthly payroll inputs to the Accounts team and support resolution of employee queries related to attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and employee records
  • Maintain HR documentation required for audits, compliance, and insurance-related processes

    2) People Processes and Employee Experience
    • Drive probation confirmations, salary revision documentation, promotions, role changes, and related employee lifecycle actions
    • Act as a reliable first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, insurance, documentation, and routine employment matters
    • Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives including birthdays, work anniversaries, festive celebrations, team activities, culture-building efforts, and internal learning sessions
    • Support employee well-being initiatives, feedback surveys, POSH-related coordination, and periodic learning and development facilitation
    • Ensure a smooth, professional, and employee-friendly HR experience across key people touchpoints

      3) Employee Relations and Governance
      • Support managers on policy interpretation, employee discipline matters, notice period discussions, underperformance cases, and other sensitive people issues, escalating when necessary
      • Maintain and update employee handbook, leave policy, code of conduct, and day-to-day HR process documentation
      • Help strengthen governance by ensuring HR processes are followed consistently and documentation is maintained accurately
      • Own HR workflow updates, template changes, automation requests, and coordination with system partners for issue resolution

        4) Recruitment Coordination and Business Support
        • Provide recruitment governance support by coordinating hiring intake, role approvals, interview process adherence, and hiring progress tracking with stakeholders
        • Partner with the recruiter and hiring managers on offer approvals, parity checks, onboarding readiness, and seamless handover from recruitment to people operations
        • Support hiring execution directly during peak hiring periods or when business needs require additional recruitment bandwidth
        • Ensure recruitment ownership is approached with flexibility and collaboration, rather than as a rigidly separated function



          Requirements
          Must-Have Skills and Experience
          • 45 years of relevant experience in HR operations, people operations, or HR generalist roles
          • Strong hands-on experience managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit
          • Working knowledge of HRMS platforms , preferably Zoho People
          • Solid experience in onboarding, HR documentation, leave and attendance management, payroll input coordination, and employee records management
          • Ability to independently handle employee queries and routine people operations matters in a timely and professional manner
          • Good understanding of HR policies, process documentation, compliance coordination, and governance practices
          • Experience supporting employee engagement initiatives and people experience programs
          • Strong coordination skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with recruiters, managers, Accounts, IT, and leadership
          • Willingness to support recruitment execution when required by business demand
          • Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, process discipline, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment

            Preferred Skills / Nice to Have
            • Proficiency in Zoho People and Zoho Recruit for HR operations and recruitment coordination
            • Ability to make backend changes, workflow updates, and system-level process improvements in Zoho tools
            • Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling HR processes for operational efficiency
            • Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption in HR , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools
            • Awareness of evolving HR technology trends and the ability to suggest process or system improvements
            • Prior experience working in UX/UI, development, branding, creative, or marketing agency environments will be preferred for stronger business and cultural fit

              Education
              • Bachelor degree in any discipline
              • Relevant work experience and practical HR capability will be valued more than academic specialization

                What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days
                By the end of the first 90 days, success in this role would look like:
                • You have taken ownership of day-to-day HR operations and are independently managing core employee lifecycle processes with minimal supervision
                • Employee records, onboarding documentation, leave and attendance tracking, and routine HR workflows are well organized and running smoothly in Zoho People
                • Payroll inputs are being shared accurately and on time, with fewer follow-ups or errors
                • New joiner onboarding is structured, timely, and well-coordinated across HR, IT, and other stakeholders
                • Employee queries are being responded to promptly and professionally, creating a dependable HR support experience
                • Key HR documents, templates, and policy/process trackers are updated, easy to access, and better organized than before
                • At least a few process improvement opportunities have been identified and implemented across HR operations, workflows, or system usage
                • Employee engagement and people experience initiatives are being run consistently with strong coordination and follow-through
                • Recruitment governance is running smoothly, with proper coordination between hiring managers, recruiter, and internal stakeholders
                • During high hiring periods, you are able to step in and support recruitment execution without losing grip on core HR operations
                • You have built trust with employees, managers, the recruiter, and the COO as a reliable owner of people operations

                  Who You Are
                  • Hands-on and dependable, with a strong bias for execution
                  • Comfortable balancing structure, empathy, and responsiveness in day-to-day HR work
                  • Process-minded, organized, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing detail
                  • Collaborative and practical in approach, with the confidence to work closely with managers and leadership
                  • Adaptable enough to support both people operations and hiring priorities as needed



                    Benefits
                    This role offers the opportunity to build meaningful impact across people operations in a growing business environment. You will help shape core HR processes, improve employee experience, support managers and teams, and bring structure and consistency to the people function while partnering closely with leadership.
                    At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique:
                    Unmatched Growth Opportunities :
                    • Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions.
                    • Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions.
                      A Work Environment That Inspires:
                      • Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being.
                      • Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements.
                        Health and Wellness Focus

Business Title
QA Manager
Years of Experience
10+
Job Descreption
The purpose of this role is to ensure the developed software meets the client requirements and the business quality standards within the project release cycle and established processes. To lead QA technical initiatives in order to optimize the test approach and tools.
Must have skills
1.At least 2 years in a lead role.
2.Experience with Azure cloud.
3.Testing file-based data lake solutions or Big data based solution.
4.Worked on migration or implementation of Azure Data Factory projects.
5.Strong experience in ETL/data pipeline testing, preferably with Azure Data Factory.
6.Proficiency in SQL for data validation and test automation.
7.Familiarity with Azure services: Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Logic Apps.
8.Experience with test management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail).
9.Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integration of QA in DevOps workflows.
10.Experience with data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Deequ).
11.Knowledge of Python or PySpark for data testing automation.
12.Exposure to Power BI or other BI tools for test result visualization.
13.Azure Data Factory
14.Exposure to Azure Databricks
15.SQL/stored procedure on SQL Server
16.ADLS Gen2
17.Exposure to Python/ Shell script
Good to have skills
1.Exposure to any ETL tool experience.
2.Any other Cloud experience (AWS / GCP).
3.Exposure to Spark architecture, including Spark Core, Spark SQL, DataFrame, Spark Streaming, and fault tolerance mechanisms.
4.ISTQB or equivalent QA certification.
5.Working experience on JIRA and Agile
6.Experience with testing SOAP / API projects
7.Stakeholder communication
8. Microsoft Office
Key responsibiltes
1.Lead the QA strategy, planning, and execution for ADF-based data pipelines and workflows.
2.Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test automation for data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes.
3.Validate data accuracy, completeness, and integrity across source systems, staging, and target data stores (e.g., Azure SQL, Synapse, Data Lake).
4.Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and business analysts to understand data flows and ensure test coverage.
5.Develop and maintain automated data validation scripts using tools like PySpark, SQL, PowerShell, or Azure Data Factory Data Flows.
6.Monitor and report on data quality metrics, defects, and test coverage.
7.Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and privacy standards.
8.Mentor junior QA team members and coordinate testing efforts across sprints.
Education Qulification
1. Minimum Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
Certification If Any
1. Any Basic level certification in AZURE
2. Snowflake Associate / Core
Shift timing
12 PM to 9 PM and / or 2 PM to 11 PM - IST time zone
Location:
DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid
Brand:
Merkle
Time Type:
Full time

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring execution for ProCreator, with a strong focus on creative and technical roles across UI/UX Design, Graphics/Visual design, Product Design, and Frontend/Backend development .
This role is ideal for someone who can independently drive recruitment from role intake through offer closure and pre-joining engagement, while partnering closely with hiring managers, HR, and leadership. The recruiter will be responsible not just for execution, but also for improving hiring workflows, maintaining strong candidate experience, and contributing to more efficient, insight-led recruitment operations.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience hiring for agency-style and technical environments, understands the nuances of assessing both creative and technical talent, and is comfortable using modern tools and AI-enabled workflows to improve hiring quality and speed.

Key Responsibilities
Talent Acquisition Execution
  • Own end-to-end recruitment for design and technology roles, especially across UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end developer hiring.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and create or refine job descriptions, candidate assessments, hiring tasks, and interview questions.
  • Publish and manage open roles across ATS platforms, LinkedIn, job boards, social channels, and relevant sourcing platforms.
  • Drive proactive sourcing, outreach, screening, and shortlisting of candidates aligned to role requirements and agency-specific expectations.
  • Conduct recruiter screening conversations to assess candidate fit across experience, role relevance, communication, motivations, and compensation expectations.
  • Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely movement of qualified candidates through each stage of the process.
  • Coordinate assessments, collect submissions, share them with hiring teams, and drive follow-through on interview stages.
    Stakeholder and Candidate Management
    • Schedule and coordinate interviews across stakeholders while ensuring a smooth and timely process.
    • Gather structured interview feedback and keep hiring managers aligned on candidate status, risks, and next steps.
    • Deliver a strong candidate experience through clear communication, expectation setting, and timely closure at every stage.
    • Support offer discussions, compensation alignment, document collection, and candidate negotiation in partnership with HR and leadership.
    • Maintain pre-joining engagement with selected candidates to reduce drop-offs and ensure smooth transition until joining.
      Recruitment Operations and Talent Strategy
      • Build and maintain talent pipelines and market maps for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
      • Work with external agencies, campus partners, and niche talent sources when required.
      • Maintain ATS hygiene and ensure accurate candidate records, stage tracking, notes, and follow-ups across all active roles.
      • Track recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, funnel conversion, aging positions, and closure timelines, and share insights with relevant stakeholders.
      • Contribute to employer branding from a hiring lens through candidate-facing communication, hiring-related content, and brand perception across recruitment platforms.
      • Document and improve recruitment workflows, interview scorecards, candidate communication templates, and best practices to support operational efficiency and scale.



        Requirements

        Must-Have Skills and Experience
        • 45 years of relevant recruitment experience in an in-house, agency, digital, product studio, or tech/services hiring environment .
        • Strong experience hiring for technical and creative roles , especially in areas such as UI/UX, visual design, product design, and front-end development .
        • Ability to independently manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake to offer closure and pre-joining engagement.
        • Strong sourcing and outreach capability across multiple channels and platforms.
        • Experience partnering with hiring managers to define role requirements and improve hiring quality.
        • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment and momentum across hiring teams.
        • Experience managing ATS workflows and maintaining strong process discipline and candidate tracking hygiene.
        • Experience coordinating interviews, managing assessments, and ensuring a smooth candidate journey.
        • Ability to evaluate candidates on role relevance, functional capability, communication, and compensation fit.
        • Experience supporting offer management and negotiation in coordination with HR and business leaders.
        • Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously.
          Preferred / Bonus Skills
          • Experience working with Zoho Recruit ATS .
          • Experience creating, streamlining, and scaling recruitment processes for better operational efficiency.
          • Prior hiring exposure in a UX/UI agency , digital agency, product studio, or similar fast-paced creative-tech environment.
          • Tech-savvy mindset with interest in AI adoption within recruitment , including automation, analytics, chatbots, and AI-enabled hiring tools.
          • Awareness of evolving recruitment technology trends and the ability to suggest process, workflow, or system improvements.
            Educational Qualification
            • Bachelor degree in any discipline is acceptable.
            • Relevant prior recruitment experience will be valued more strongly than academic specialization.
              What Success Looks Like in 90 Days
              • Takes confident ownership of active hiring mandates across design and technical roles with minimal handholding.
              • Builds strong working relationships with hiring managers and establishes credibility through responsiveness, judgment, and process ownership.
              • Maintains clean and reliable ATS data, clear pipeline visibility, and disciplined follow-ups across open roles.
              • Improves quality and speed of shortlisting through stronger sourcing, screening, and role understanding.
              • Creates a smoother and more professional candidate experience across scheduling, communication, and closure.
              • Brings structure to assessments, interview coordination, and feedback collection.
              • Begins identifying practical opportunities to improve hiring workflows, reduce delays, and strengthen recruitment operations.




                Benefits Benefits
                At ProCreator, were not just offering a job; were providing a platform for you to thrive, grow, and lead. Here what makes us unique:
                Unmatched Growth Opportunities :
                • Wealth-Building Benefits : ESOPs, Shared Appreciation Rights (SAR), profit-sharing, and referral bonuses to recognize your contributions.
                • Skill Development : Access professional growth funds, learning courses, and mentorship programs tailored to your ambitions.
                  A Work Environment That Inspires:
                  • Comfort Redefined: Ergonomic furniture, standing desks, and training for optimal productivity and well-being.
                  • Flexibility : We offer the flexibility of working from the office as well as hybrid work arrangements.
                    Health and Wellness Focus :
                    • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Insurance up to INR 5,00,000.
                    • Team Bonding Retreats: Strengthen connections and recharge during annual team-building getaways.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced AI Quality & Model Evaluation Lead to drive quality assurance, healthcare audit validation, AI/ML evaluation, and production readiness for AI-powered healthcare solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in software testing, healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), statistical quality methodologies, AI/ML model evaluation, and Generative AI assessment.

Required Skill Set

  • QA & Software Testing (Functional, Integration, Regression, API, Data Validation, Test Planning and Execution)
  • AI/ML Model Evaluation (Model Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Sensitivity, Specificity, Benchmark and Ground-Truth Validation)

  • Healthcare RCM (Medical Coding Validation, Clinical Documentation Review, AR Denial Management, Prior Authorization, and Audit Methodology)

Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills
